jobs.title: Fabrication & Project Coordinator, Computer 3-d/2-d drafting — Seed Design & Build
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Fabrication \& Project Coordinator specializing in Computer\-Aided Design (CAD) 3D/2D drafting to join our innovative design and build team. In this role, you will be the key driver behind translating conceptual ideas into precise fabrication drawings and project plans, ensuring seamless coordination between design, engineering, and fabrication teams. Your expertise will help bring complex projects to life through meticulous drafting, modeling, and documentation, all while maintaining a vibrant, energetic workflow that propels projects forward. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to cutting\-edge design\-build projects, utilizing advanced CAD software and building information modeling (BIM) tools to deliver exceptional results.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop detailed 3D models and 2D drawings using CAD software such as AutoCAD, Revit, MicroStation, or SolidWorks for fabrication and construction purposes
* Collaborate closely with project managers, engineers, and fabricators to ensure design intent is accurately translated into fabrication\-ready schematics and documentation
* Utilize BIM tools like Revit and NavisWorks to coordinate project models, identify clashes, and streamline construction workflows
* Create precise schematics, mechanical drafting, and CAD documentation that adhere to project specifications and industry standards
* Assist in the development of construction sequences by producing 2D animations or visualizations for client presentations and internal reviews
* Maintain organized CAD files, version control, and project records to ensure easy access and seamless updates throughout project lifecycle
* Support fabrication teams by providing clear technical drawings, assembly instructions, and mechanical design details necessary for manufacturing

**Experience**

* Proven experience with CAD software including AutoCAD, SketchUp, NavisWorks, Civil 3D, MicroStation, SolidWorks, Revit or similar platforms
* Strong background in mechanical drafting and engineering CAD design within construction or fabrication environments
* Familiarity with building information modeling (BIM) tools for integrated project coordination
* Knowledge of schematics creation, CAD detailing, mechanical design processes, and construction documentation standards
* Hands\-on experience with 3D CAD modeling and 2D animation techniques for visualizing complex projects
* Prior involvement in construction projects or fabrication workflows that require detailed drafting and technical precision
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings and schematics accurately while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary teams

Join us to be part of a vibrant team dedicated to transforming innovative ideas into tangible realities! This role is perfect for passionate professionals eager to leverage their CAD expertise in a fast\-paced environment that values creativity, precision, and teamwork.

Pay: $40,000\.00 \- $45,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Construction Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Construction Project Coordinator**

Position Summary

**Who We Are**

D\&H Contractors builds and renovates homes on the Westside of Los Angeles. Brentwood, Bel Air, Pacific Palisades, Santa Monica, Beverly Hills. Our projects are large, detailed, and held to a standard our clients can see every day, because they live in them.

We are a family\-oriented general contracting company. Our team is small enough that every person here has a direct hand in the finished result, and no one’s work disappears into a process. We are growing, and we intend to grow with the people we hire.

**Who We Are Looking For**

We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented **Construction Project Coordinator** to support residential construction projects throughout Los Angeles.

The people who do well here take ownership without being asked twice. They catch the detail that is off before the client does. They follow up, answer the phone, and raise a problem early rather than hoping it resolves itself. They care what the finished work looks like.

If you want a role where your judgment matters and your work is visible, this is the role.

This position requires both office and field work. The ideal candidate will regularly visit job sites, review construction drawings, coordinate with contractors and vendors, order construction materials, and help keep projects on schedule and within budget. What You Will Do

* Support the project team across multiple residential construction and development projects simultaneously.
* Visit job sites regularly to track progress and confirm work is being built to plan and specification.
* Read and interpret architectural, structural, MEP, and shop drawings.
* Prepare material take\-offs from drawings and place material orders.
* Ensure materials are ordered and delivered according to the construction schedule.
* Coordinate with our subcontractors, architects, engineers, inspectors, and city agencies.
* Track schedules, RFIs, submittals, change orders, inspections, and punch lists.
* Attend site meetings and follow up on outstanding action items.
* Verify completed work complies with project drawings and quality standards.
* Source quotes from vendors and subcontractors, review invoices, purchase orders, and contractor payment requests.
* Keep project documentation, permits, and reports organized and up to date.
* Perform additional project\-related duties as assigned.

**What You Bring**

* Two or more years in construction coordination, project coordination, or assistant project management
* Ability to read and understand construction drawings. This is not negotiable.
* Working knowledge of LADBS \& permitting process, OSHA regulations, and Southern California construction codes.
* Experience coordinating with contractors, vendors, and suppliers.
* Strong organization, clear communication, and the instinct to solve a problem rather than pass it along.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Proficient in Google Workspace (docs, Sheets, slides, etc.)
* Experience with Bluebeam, Procore, AutoCAD, or similar construction software is a plus.
* Valid California driver's license and reliable transportation.
* Willingness to travel to construction sites throughout the Los Angeles metro area.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish.

**Helpful, Not Required**

* Experience on high\-end residential renovation, custom homes, or additions
* Experience performing material take\-offs and ordering materials from drawings
* Familiarity with Bluebeam, Procore, AutoCad, Houzz Pro, or similar construction software.
* Purchasing and procurement experience.

This position offers the opportunity for long\-term growth. Compensation is based on experience.

Work Location: In person

**How To Apply**

Send your resume to , along with a short note about a project you are proud of and your role in it. We read them.

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: PROGRAM COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
#### **Reports to – Senior Program Manager**


#### **Organization Overview**


Baby2Baby is a non\-profit organization that provides children in need with diapers, formula, clothing, and the basic necessities that every child deserves, serving more than one million children across all 50 states. Over the past 15 years, Baby2Baby has distributed over half a billion items to children in homeless shelters, domestic violence programs, foster care, hospitals and school districts as well as children who have lost everything in the wake of disaster. The organization’s success has been propelled forward by it’s industry\-leading model that is redefining what it means to operate a nonprofit with a seamless integration of impact, innovation, and influence, which earned them praise from TIME Magazine as one of 2023’s most influential companies and recognition as the \#1 nonprofit on Fast Company’s World’s Most Innovative Companies List.


#### **Position Overview**


Reporting to the Senior Manager, Program, the Program Coordinator, will support the coordination of distributing essential items to partner organizations across the western region. This role is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operations by maintaining databases, processing donation requests, and coordinating item distribution logistics.The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, and comfortable in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment.


The Program Coordinator will work at Baby2Baby’s HQ. The work is performed in an office setting and is currently on site 3\-5 days per week with potential visits to partner organizations.


#### **Duties and Responsibilities**


* Serves as a key liaison for partner organizations, managing communications and providing support.
* Collects donation requests from partner organizations, synthesizes needs, and enters data into Baby2Baby’s warehouse management system to help facilitate accurate and timely distribution.
* Maintains and updates partner databases, ensuring accurate tracking of organization and contact information.
* Coordinates enrollment for specialized bundle programs, working with internal departments and partner organizations.
* Monitors current events and news to contribute to the weekly news report, helping the team stay informed on emerging issues affecting the communities we serve.
* Supports Senior Program Manager with researching and vetting new partner organizations.
* Participates in and coordinates orientations for new partners on Baby2Baby programs and procedures.
* Participates in the execution of regular in\-person distribution days along with community site visits.
* Supports development and programmatic events such as annual distributions and volunteer sessions, as needed.
* Performs additional duties as assigned.

#### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
* 2 or more years of experience in a program support, operations, or a related role.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and maintain accuracy.
* Strong organizational skills with a key attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace and Google Sheets.
* Strong commitment to Baby2Baby’s mission and values.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Conversational Spanish language skills.

#### **Salary**

This role’s salary range is between $24\-$26/hr. Actual salary is determined based on a number of factors, including but not limited to your relevant skills, qualifications, and years of experience.


#### **Other**


**Baby2Baby is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering diversity within its staff.** We have made diverse thinking a priority in order to keep our organization in touch with the needs of families in our program and to help hold us accountable to those we serve. Our organization strives for diversity, from the children we serve to our board and staff, not only in race, age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, and religion but also in cultural background and life experiences.

**Growth Opportunity:** This position is intended to grow into a full\-time role as UFIT’s programs and operational needs expand. The timing of the transition will be based on organizational growth, workload, and the coordinator’s demonstrated performance and reliability.

 **About UFIT**



UFIT provides structured sports, physical education, and youth development programs for schools and community partners throughout Los Angeles County. Our programs combine physical activity, skill development, social\-emotional learning, and exposure to college and career pathways through sports.



We are seeking an organized, resourceful Program Operations Coordinator who can keep our programs, communications, marketing, and internal systems moving forward. This is a hands\-on coordination role for someone who follows through, catches details, uses technology confidently, and does not need constant supervision.

 **Position Overview**



The Program Operations Coordinator will support the Founder and work closely with UFIT’s recruitment and field leadership team. This person will coordinate operational tasks, maintain accurate systems and records, manage administrative follow\-up, and ensure UFIT’s marketing communications are consistently prepared and published.



This role will begin part\-time and is expected to develop into a full\-time position as UFIT expands. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the organization, take on greater responsibility over time, and help build the operational structure needed to support that growth.



The right candidate knows how to use AI and automation to work efficiently—but also understands that technology does not replace accuracy, judgment, quality control, or personal accountability.

 **Key Responsibilities**

  

Program Operations


* Maintain program calendars, deadlines, school information, staffing records, and operational trackers.
* Coordinate administrative details for new and existing school programs.
* Prepare and organize program documents, quotes, schedules, reports, and internal communications.
* Track assignments, approvals, missing information, and follow\-up items through completion.
* Support communication between UFIT administration, school partners, coaches, and program leadership.
* Review documents and systems for accuracy before information is distributed.
* Provide the Founder with clear updates on completed work, pending decisions, and potential problems.

  



Marketing and Communications


* Maintain UFIT’s social media, email marketing, and outreach calendar.
* Use AI\-supported tools to create first drafts of emails, graphics, captions, flyers, and campaign content.

* Monitor basic campaign results, including opens, clicks, responses, and engagement.
* Keep marketing materials current, professional, and aligned with UFIT’s brand.
* Maintain organized folders containing approved graphics, videos, templates, and campaign materials.

  



Systems and Administrative Coordination


* Maintain accurate information across Google Workspace, BambooHR, the training platform, CRM/email marketing tools, and other UFIT systems.
* Support employee onboarding documentation and ensure required information is entered correctly.
* Verify that automated forms, emails, workflows, and integrations are functioning as intended.
* Identify duplicate, outdated, missing, or incorrectly filed information.
* Coordinate software issues with the appropriate vendor or developer and track them until resolved.
* Research practical AI tools and automations that can reduce repetitive administrative work.
* Create and maintain straightforward procedures for recurring operational tasks.

  


**What This Position Is Not**



This position is not responsible for recruiting coaches, directly training the coaching staff, supervising daily school\-site performance, developing software, or independently changing UFIT policies. The coordinator supports these functions by keeping the information, systems, communications, and follow\-up organized.

* At least three years of experience in operations, project coordination, executive support, program administration, or a similar position.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple deadlines and assignments without losing track of details.

* Practical experience using AI tools to improve productivity and content development.
* Ability to identify problems, communicate them promptly, and recommend realistic solutions.
* Ability to handle employee and business information confidentially.

**Preferred Experience**

jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**



Under the general supervision of the Director of Community Engagement and Center Principal Investigator, the Community Engagement Program Coordinator will be responsible for developing and maintaining community engagement programs, initiatives, and resources that advance the Center’s mission and goals.



About the Center:



The Charles R. Drew University of Medicine and Science (CDU) Center for Accelerating Excellence in Translational Science (AXIS) has focused on eliminating health disparities in the south Los Angeles community, particularly those related to cancer, cardiometabolic diseases, and HIV/AIDS. As an unexpected expansion in response to the needs of our local community, the entire CDU establishment also led community initiatives to improve local outcomes during the pandemic, including providing education and facilitating screening, prevention, care, and clinical trials.

  


**Essential Duties**


* Develop and Maintain community engagement programs, initiatives, and resources that advance the Center’s mission and goals
* Work with internal and external partners to identify opportunities for collaboration and resource sharing
* Serve as a liaison between the Center and various communities, promoting positive relationships and open communication
* Promote the Center’s research projects (Full, Pilot, and Supplements) to community physicians, health care providers, potential study candidates, community\-based organizations, research organizations, the CDU community, and other locations or groups
* Manage community engagement and outreach events and campaigns, including planning, logistics, budgeting, and execution of monthly and annual conferences.
* Develop marketing and promotional materials for community engagement initiatives that include social media
* Write grants and proposals to secure funding for community engagement programs
* Train and supervise staff and volunteers working on community engagement projects (i.e. Clinical Trials Education)
* Collect data and feedback from participants in community engagement programs to assess effectiveness and make necessary improvements
* Keep abreast of trends and developments in the field of community engagement and share relevant information with staff and other stakeholders
* Attend community meetings, health fairs, and events as needed to represent the Center
* Provide administrative coordination of Center’s Community Advisory Boards (Latinx \& African American)
* Perform administrative tasks related to community engagement program management, such as creating reports, PowerPoint, and maintaining records

* ##### **Four\-year college degree (B.A., B.S.) in Health Sciences. Experience in Business Administration, Public Administration, or Public Health is an advantage.**
  


**EXPERIENCE:**


* At least 2 years or more years of experience working in an academic setting or institution with responsibility for coordinating educational programs and activities.
* At least 2 or more years of experience in scientific and programmatic grant development, writing, and submission of grant proposals and reports to federal, local, and private funding agencies.
* Experience in the coordination of staff and students, including experience working in conjunction with HR. Also strongly prefer experience working with diverse partners and cultural sensitivity.
* Experience with developing and communicating, in written and oral form, detailed and technical scientific and administrative program information to various audiences.
* Has experience developing evaluation metrics to assist the Supervisor in reviewing the effectiveness of program activities, recommending improvements, and assisting in executing recommendations.

* Ability to develop and maintain professional working relationships in complex program/organizational settings involving heterogeneous constituents such as academic and clinical faculty, staff, students, and community partners from diverse backgrounds.
* Experience with interpreting operating policies and procedures and resolving minor discipline and other employee relations issues within an academic setting or institution.

  


**SKILLS**


* Demonstrated experience developing and executing community engagement strategy
* Proven ability to build relationships and partnerships with diverse groups
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Budget development and oversight experience
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Prefer basic/working knowledge of Spanish language.
* Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Court Program
jobs.description:
The primary role of the Program Coordinator is providing quality care and learning experiences for children of various abilities in mixed age groups while parents are attending to court business. Additionally, the Program Coordinator is distinguishable from the Teacher role with additional administrative and staff coordination duties supporting a small group of 1 to 5 locations within a County, District, or Local regional operating area. The Program Coordinator, under direction from their supervisor, coordinates staff schedules, various supply purchases, and data reports.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Program Facilitation \& Delivery**


* Provide care and quality learning experiences for children of multiple ages in the same setting.
* Create appropriate learning environments inclusive of children with special needs.
* Learn and implement adaptive methods and strategies for working with all children.
* Work in a culturally and linguistically sensitive manner with families from diverse backgrounds.
* Maintain files on families and record attendance as necessary.
* Develop relationships with point of contact at individual court site.
* Provide input for program planning and development.
* Refer families to local resources as needed.
* Maintain active communication with Catalyst Community staff.

**Communication**


* Establish relationships with parent and children utilizing the child care services at the courthouse.
* Maintain active communication with Catalyst Community staff located at corporate offices.
* Demonstrate ability to effectively speak and write in English.


**Customer Orientation**


* Coordinate and communicate with regional site contacts to ensure program satisfaction.
* Demonstrate a genuine openness to hearing what others think and feel and respond appropriately.
* Solicit feedback from parents/guardians utilizing services and adjust program goals as needed.
* Respond to both internal and external customers with promptness and openness.


**Interpersonal Effectiveness**


* Demonstrate sensitivity and empathy towards others.
* Clearly communicate agreements by collaboratively defining roles, specifying agreed upon goals and establishing timelines.
* Coach and provide feedback to all team staff regarding project performance and professional growth.
* Demonstrate an understanding of one’s own strengths and outline your needs to do your best work.
* Model reflective practice strategies while interacting with others.


**Planning and Organizing**


* Coordinate staff scheduling and location coverage under the direction of supervisor
* Coordinate purchasing of supplies and materials for Court Program locations using Catalyst Community procurement procedures.
* Coordinate data collection processes for quality programs and operations. Examples include attendance reports, purchasing and mileage reimbursement sheets, and program evaluations.
* Immediately address areas and issues related to planning and organizing directly with the supervisor.
* Prepare reports that summarize statewide and regional project work and distribute to key stakeholders.


**Critical Thinking**


* Demonstrate the ability to communicate theories into practice while supporting the learning process of others.
* Involve others in problem solving situations by gathering accurate information and analyzing suggested solutions.
* Recognize emotion yet draw upon facts and information when determining solutions.
* Maintain and project a calm demeanor while problem solving with internal and external partners.
* Additional tasks as assigned.

  

  

**Required Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Child Development (CD), Early Childhood Education (ECE), or related field
* 2\-3 years’ experience in CD/ECE

  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Bilingual English/Spanish
* Experience working with non\-English speakers and those from diverse cultural backgrounds

  

  

**Key Competencies:**


* Ability to observe, plan and articulate children’s developmental play, knowledge of developmental stages, ability to work effectively with mixed age groups, ability to work collaboratively and responsively within a team setting
* Be physically and mentally capable of interacting with children from 6 weeks to 13 years of age, meeting all their needs and ensuring their safety
* Excellent communication skills in English
* Customer service oriented
* Strong communication skills, ability to work in potentially stressful situations, and self\-confidence to work independently

  

  

**Working Conditions:**


* Must be able to work in a formal office setting with no access to yard space
* Must be comfortable completing a security screening when entering work site
* Frequent bending, lifting, twisting and reaching
* Generally pleasant working conditions
* Less than 50% of daily assignments involve prolonged physical effort
* Travel: Up to 50% regionally
  


**Shift Type:** Full Time, Onsite


**Schedule:** Monday \- Friday, 8am \- 5pm

  


**What We Offer:**

* 401(k) Retirement plan and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Personal Health Advocate
* Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays
* Commuter pre\-tax benefit
* Discounted childcare

jobs.title: Social Worker (Program Coordinator)
jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------


Social Worker (Program Coordinator), Community Engagement \& Reintegration Service (CERS), GS\-0185\-12, Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Greater Los Angeles Healthcare System, Los Angeles, CA.  

  



Learn more about this agency


  
**This job is open to**
-----------------------


### **The public**


U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.
### **Clarification from the agency**


NOTE: The 2\-page Resume requirement does not apply to this position. For more information, refer to Required Documents below.


  
**Duties**
----------


**VA Careers \- Licensed Clinical Social Worker**: https://youtube.com/embed/U\_xC25QsN0w  

  

Total Rewards of a Allied Health Professional  

  

The position is located at the Greater Los Angeles Healthcare System West Los Angeles Campus within the Community Engagement and Reintegration Service (CERS). The incumbent is a Licensed Social Worker at the advanced practice level assigned to the Health Care for Homeless Veterans (HCHV) Contracted Residential Services (CRS). The HCHV CRS Liaison is responsible for the monitoring and coordination of services provided by community\-based programs funded under the VA emergency housing contracts.  

  

Program coordinators at the GS\-12 grade level are administratively responsible for a clinical program providing treatment to Veterans in a major specialty area, such as but not limited to: the Chronically Homeless population with or without active SUD and/or Mental Health conditions and diagnosis. Veteran's with behavioral and/or suicidal flags or with barriers for permanent housing. They will build relationship with various VA services such as with the Homeless, Continuum Veterans Program, Suicide Prevention Program, Veteran Justice Outreach and many others. The program coordinator may be the sole practitioner in this specialty at the facility and typically provide direct patient care services in the program area.  

  

The program coordinator oversees the daily operation of the community contracted program, supports the development of policies and procedures for program operation, and prepares reports and statistics for facility, VISN, and national use. They may be responsible for the program's budget, developing and monitoring staff compliance with practice, standards and guidelines on documentation, workload, data entry, ethical practice and service delivery. The program coordinator provides analysis and evaluation of clinical program data and computerized programs to identify system\-wide trends and needs to enhance the quality of service. They may be responsible for, or contribute to, the program's resource and fiscal management, monitoring control points developing the annual budget, operating within that budget, and accounting for appropriated funds.  

  

The program coordinator is administratively responsible for the clinical programming and prepares reports and statistics for facility, VISN, and national use. They provide leadership, direction, orientation, coaching, in\-service training, and technical support for staff development. They initiate and conduct a variety of program or service audits and complete designated clinical practice audits and reports, including productivity assessments. They oversee program operations and evaluations, identifying areas for improvement, gathering relevant data, assessing the data, developing and implementing ideas for improvement and evaluating efficacy of improvement efforts.  

  

The incumbent will also be required to operate Government Furnished Equipment (Motor Vehicle) to frequently travel into the community as required.  

  

  

**Work Schedule**: Full\-time, Monday\-Friday, 8:00 am\-4:30 pm  

**Compressed/Flexible**: Not authorized  

**Telework**: Ad hoc, may be available after the first 90 days of employment  

**Virtual:** This is not a virtual position.  

**Functional Statement \#**: 00000


  
**Requirements**
----------------


### **Conditions of employment**


* You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this job.
* Selective Service Registration is required for males born after 12/31/1959\.
* Must be proficient in written and spoken English.
* You may be required to serve a probationary period.
* Subject to background/security investigation.
* Selected applicants will be required to complete an online onboarding process.
* Must pass pre\-employment physical examination.
* Participation in the seasonal influenza vaccination program is a requirement for all Department of Veterans Affairs Health Care Personnel (HCP).
* Complete all application requirements detailed in the "Required Documents" section of this announcement.


### **Qualifications**


**Basic Requirements**


* **Citizenship:** Citizen of the United States.

jobs.title: Inbound/Outbound Account Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Hanjin Intermodal America, Inc.** is a leading global supply chain company that provides essential products, services and technology to facilitate the global movement of materials. We provide our network of hubs with all the resources to ensure timely and efficient delivery of goods to their locations. Powered by a nationwide network of strategic hubs, Hanjin Intermodal America, Inc. provides seamless transportation solutions, unmatched service, and the visibility businesses need to move with confidence.

**Job Summary**

The Inbound/Outbound Account Coordinator supports the day\-to\-day coordination and administration of domestic and international logistics operations, including Department of Defense (DoD) shipments. This role is responsible for arranging and monitoring work orders, coordinating with domestic and international agents, tracking shipments, and providing timely updates to customers. In addition, this position supports accounts payable activities by reviewing and auditing vendor invoices, processing payment requests, monitoring payment status, and resolving billing discrepancies.

Similar to a Logistics Coordinator role, this position offers greater variety and hands\-on problem\-solving, requiring the ability to navigate shipment challenges, coordinate solutions across multiple parties, and keep operations moving efficiently. You’ll be the account’s main point of contact for customers, helping answer shipment questions, troubleshoot issues, and find solutions when things don’t go as planned and actively responsible for keeping shipments, documentation, and communication moving smoothly.

**Duties\& Responsibilities**

* Arrange Domestic / International work orders
* Manage work order and follow\-up with both Domestic / International agents
* Review/audit vendor invoices and update accordingly
* Submit payment request for payment to the vendor in a timely manner
* Responsible for daily logistics operation to handle Department of Defense shipments
* Provide customer service to clients via telephone and email
* Track, trace, and update shipment data through tracing system
* Manage account payable by registering invoice, submit payment request, and track payment status
* Handle and resolve various complaint and claim from the customers
* Other related duties as assigned

**Requirements:**

* Bilingual in English and Korean (required)
* Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred
* Experience in high level coordination, regarding shipments, tracking freight, and managing transportation documentation
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple shipments, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a customer\-service\-oriented approach
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities in a fast\-paced operational environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite \& Google Suite applications
* Commitment to maintaining precise documentation and ensuring data accuracy across operational processes

Pay: $24\.00 \- $28\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Account Manager, Vessel Closure - Los Angeles, South
jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life\-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**Working at Abbott**


At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit \- an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**The Opportunity**

This is a field\-based position, supporting Abbott’s Vascular division. Abbott Vascular provides innovative, minimally invasive and cost\-effective products for treatment of vascular disease. Our extensive portfolio includes drug\-eluting stents, guide wires, balloon dilatation catheters, imaging catheters and software, vessel closure devices, peripheral stents, thrombectomy catheters and atherectomy devices.


We currently have an opportunity available for an **Account Manager, Vessel Closure in Southern CA.** This role will be responsible for ensuring that the assigned territory meets or exceeds sales objectives and delivers profitable growth/market share expectations aligned with the quarterly and annual plan. The Account Manager will work with, and report to, the Regional Sales Director to identify/evaluate market opportunities, business potential, and to achieve annual sales objectives in assigned territory. This individual will coordinate activities with Clinical Specialists, negotiate contracts with hospital customers, and keep the company informed of market dynamics \& competitive activity.

**What You’ll Work On**

* Primary responsibility is to lead all commercial selling activity for the assigned territory by focusing on Electrophysiologists, Vascular Surgeons, Interventional Cardiologists, and Interventional Radiologists to promote the complete Vessel Closure portfolio including small and large bore arterial, venous, and future product releases. This includes influencing stakeholders within the hospital, driving product utilization, support on contracting, relationship development, relationship management, market development and serving as the primary owner for sales target achievement of the designated territory.
* Secondary responsibility is to support clinical selling activity and some procedure case service. This includes selling on clinical differentiation in the procedure, value proposition, product launch, physician onboarding, early case coverage and training.
* Influence stakeholders within the hospital setting.
* Drive product utilization in key growth categories and driving sales/placement of capital to support product utilization.
* Support contracting efforts to gain favorable positions in accounts within the territory.
* Drive market development in new product segments and new product launches.
* Meet with current and potential customers to fulfill revenue and unit growth objectives assigned by company on a monthly / quarterly /annual basis.
* Develop and implement sales strategies by determining the relevant factors (e.g., product, competition, and pricing needs) of existing and potential accounts to effectively promote the company's products to appropriate hospital personnel and physicians.
* Develop action plans (i.e., weekly, quarterly, monthly) by analyzing quarterly and monthly sales figures and reports identifying the needs of accounts and discussing issues with the Regional Sales Director to help the organization achieve its sales goals.
* Develop relationships with hospital personnel and identify key purchasing decision makers in order to facilitate sales growth.
* Strengthen customer relationships by performing sales support activities (e.g., product training, therapy awareness., education events).
* Build networks of contacts to stimulate interest in the company’s products by attending and participating in trade shows, educational conferences, and seminars.
* Maintain clinical and technical expertise by attending company product training sessions.
* Prepare and submit reports to sales management by analyzing and compiling data, projections, and other relevant information.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
* 3\-5\+ years of related work experience
* Ability to travel 50% within assigned region

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Preferred background includes prior experience selling in the medical device industry

**Apply Now**

**Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:** www.abbottbenefits.com


Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.


Connect with us at www.abbott.com, on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on Twitter @AbbottNews.

  

The base pay for this position is $61,300\.00 – $122,700\.00\. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

jobs.title: Institutional Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Description**  



  

This is an Institutional Account Manager position in a startup Pharma organization being built to launch a cardiovascular product in the critical care space. Reporting to the Syneos Health Area Business Director, the Account Manager will be responsible for engaging key stakeholders within complex hospital accounts, institutional systems and integrated delivery networks (IDNs).

**Responsibilities:**

* Maximize relationships with key academic institutions, IDNs and GPOs and leverage these relationships to generate increased demand and access for the product by targeting appropriate prescribers and decision influencers within the hospital.
* Partner with health systems to influence heads of departments, service line leaders, RNs, floor directors, and hospital pharmacy to secure formulary access and pull through of product utilization in the Hospital.
* Increase adoption and pull through of institutional/GPO contracts.
* Partner with administrators within health systems to remove barriers to appropriate use of product.
* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross\-functional discipline is critical. Cross\-functional partners may consist of Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources to determine strategies and tactics for business decision\-making.
* Demonstrate account\-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.). Build relationships in institutions aligned with customer segmentation.
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Develop a complete understanding of the health care delivery system within each assigned customer, including the physician hierarchy, key pharmacy personnel, clinical nursing staff, etc.
* Collaboratively build account plans with field colleagues and leadership, that will increase demand and patient care.
* Develop deep product and competitor knowledge and understanding of local and regional market trends.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in required training and development programs.
* Maintain adherence and compliance with all corporate, industry policies and procedures.

**Requirements:**

* BA/BS degree required.
* 5\+ years pharmaceutical/biotech sales experience.
* 2\+ years cardiovascular sales experience in the Hospital setting is required.
* Hospital/Institutional experience highly preferred.
* Knowledge of formulary approval process and driving formulary approvals is preferred.
* Must live within territory or within territory boundaries.
* Proven track record of success in a high science competitive selling environment.
* Ability to identify key decision makers, develop positive relationships and strong customer dedication.
* Self\-starter, highly motivated to succeed.
* Strong communication, business analytics and account management skills.
* Ability to work independently or in a team environment.


The annual base salary for this position ranges from $155,000 to $170,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Here, the work is challenging, and the pace is exhilarating. By joining one of our commercial teams, you’re empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy that you need. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Syneos Health has launched more sales teams in the last 5 years across all major therapeutic areas than the top 25 pharma companies combined. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

  

At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Title: Account Manager \- Commercial Lines**

**Remote:** Arizona**,** California, Idaho, Nevada, Oregon, Utah and Washington residents

**Supporting:** IOA \- Salt Lake City \| **Book Focus:** Commercial Transportation \& Trucking

**Requirement:** active P\&C license and commercial transportation/trucking experience  

  

*Please note: If this position is posted as either fully remote and/or hybrid, in accordance with company policy, individuals residing within a 50\-mile radius of a branch location may be required to work onsite in a hybrid capacity as there may be occasions when on\-site presence is necessary to meet specific business needs. Additionally, our remote work policy includes having a dedicated, distraction\-free workspace.* *Remote work is not a substitute for childcare, elder care, or other personal responsibilities during working hours.* *To view our branch locations, please visit: ioausa.com/locations*  

  

**About the Role****:** Manage an assigned book of business, ensuring account retention and supporting new business. Coordinate day\-to\-day administrative and customer service activities, resolving complex issues, and ensuring no errors or omissions.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Technical Competence**: Maintain technical competence and industry expertise.
* **Team Leadership**: Direct daily activities of the account management team.
* **Customer Service**: Handle customer service requests, policy administration, billing, claims, and coverage analysis.
* **Policy Management**: Manage policy expirations and renewals.
* **Renewal Process**: Conduct client research, prepare submissions, negotiate coverages, and present proposals.
* **Accounts Receivable**: Monitor reports and take action on delinquent accounts, collecting outstanding balances.
* **System Maintenance**: Maintain agency management systems and carrier/vendor platforms, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
* **Activity Monitoring:** Monitor and maintain activity/suspense to ensure timely completion.
* **Communication:** Maintain frequent, transparent communication with the account team regarding workload status and any issues.
* **Service Excellence:** Deliver excellent service, proactively anticipate needs, and respond quickly to service requests.
* **Policy Compliance:** Stay updated on company policies and procedures.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Seek and adopt best practices to improve individual and team performance.
* **Champion IOA Values:** Demonstrate integrity and leadership.
  

  

**Ideal Candidate** **Qualifications:**

* 3\+ years of account management experience, or 5\+ years in the insurance industry
* Thorough knowledge of insurance brokerage and client needs
* Required active licensing; professional designation (CIC or equivalent) preferred
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills
* Exceptional customer service, communication, multitasking, and organizational skills

jobs.title: LearnVantage Software Sales Account Exec Manager Enterprise Account Management
jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Accenture LearnVantage is Accenture's comprehensive technology learning and training service, built on a $1 billion investment to help the world's leading organizations reskill and upskill their workforces for the AI economy. Launched in March 2024, LearnVantage brings together three industry\-leading training organizations — Udacity (AI, data science, and digital skills), Award Solutions (advanced wireless, 5G, and network technologies), and Ascendient Learning (instructor\-led IT training and vendor\-authorized certifications) — into a single, AI\-powered platform that delivers personalized, outcomes\-driven workforce transformation at enterprise scale.


We sit at the intersection of Accenture's deepest client relationships and the most urgent workforce challenge in the market: helping global enterprises close the AI skills gap at speed and at scale. With Accenture's trust, reach, and account access as our foundation, LearnVantage is positioned to become the defining workforce reinvention partner for the world's most important organizations.

**You Are:**


A strategic, relationship\-driven enterprise seller who knows how to navigate large, complex organizations — both externally with clients and internally within Accenture. You are equally comfortable sitting in an account planning session with a Managing Director as you are presenting a workforce reinvention business case to a client's CHRO. You understand how Accenture operates, how Diamond Account teams think, and how to position LearnVantage as a natural, high\-value extension of the work Accenture is already doing.


You are not a lone wolf. You are a collaborator, an orchestrator, and a trusted partner to the Accenture account teams you work alongside. You know that in this environment, internal influence is as important as external selling — and you have the credibility, patience, and commercial instincts to build both.

**The Work:**

* Embed within Accenture's Diamond Account and strategic account teams as the dedicated LearnVantage sales resource, attending account planning sessions, QBRs, and client meetings to identify and qualify workforce reinvention opportunities within active Accenture engagements
* Build trusted, recurring relationships with Client Account Leads (CALs), Managing Directors, and Accenture industry leads across assigned accounts, establishing yourself as the go\-to LearnVantage expert within the Accenture ecosystem
* Identify the right moment to introduce LearnVantage into active Accenture transformation programs — attaching AI, data, cloud, networking, and certification training to technology implementations, managed services agreements, and change management programs already underway
* Lead executive\-level discovery and solution presentations with client C\-suite stakeholders (CIO, CHRO, CDO, CEO, CLO), positioned as a strategic LearnVantage partner rather than a training vendor add\-on
* Design comprehensive LearnVantage workforce solutions — drawing on LearnVantage AI programs, Award Solutions 5G and network training, and Ascendient Learning IT certification — that complement and accelerate the technology transformations Accenture is delivering
* Present value\-selling business cases that connect LearnVantage investments to measurable client outcomes: AI capability development, technology adoption speed, workforce productivity, talent retention, and long\-term competitive readiness
* Navigate Accenture's internal commercial processes — including CCI considerations, Accenture Funding mechanisms, and co\-investment structures — with the knowledge and credibility to advocate for LearnVantage's commercial interests while maintaining strong internal relationships
* Manage LearnVantage pipeline across all assigned Accenture accounts with disciplined CRM hygiene, accurate forecasting, and regular visibility for both LearnVantage and Accenture leadership
* Convert Accenture\-introduced opportunities into closed, contracted LearnVantage engagements and expand those engagements over time into multi\-year, multi\-solution workforce partnerships
* Serve as the voice of the client and the CAL back to LearnVantage's product, curriculum, and go\-to\-market teams — surfacing emerging skill gaps, deal structure needs, and market opportunities that improve LearnVantage's relevance within the Accenture ecosystem


Travel to client sites and Accenture offices as required to support strategic account pursuits; travel estimated at 30–50% depending on assigned accounts


  

**Here's What You Need:**

* Minimum of 7 years of experience in business development, account management, sales leadership, or new logo acquisition in a consulting, technology, or professional services environment.
* Demonstrated track record of originating and closing significant net new business in mid\-market or multi\-subsidiary environments, preferably $500K\+ ARR deals or more
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

**Bonus Points If:**

* You have direct experience with Accenture's account structure, including familiarity with Diamond Accounts, CAL/MD relationships, and Accenture's internal commercial processes (CCI, Accenture Funding, co\-investment)
* You have experience selling corporate learning, AI and digital skills platforms, managed learning services, IT certification training, or workforce technology into large enterprise accounts
* You have familiarity with any LearnVantage solution area — AI/ML (Udacity), advanced wireless and 5G (Award Solutions), or instructor\-led IT certification (Ascendient Learning)
* You have experience building and scaling a co\-sell motion within a large partner or alliance ecosystem
* You have experience leading or mentoring sales talent and an interest in helping build the LearnVantage sales team as we scale
* You have existing relationships within Accenture's account teams or with the clients

jobs.description:

This role may also be located in our Playa Vista, CA campus.


Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or management consulting, or 2 years of experience with advanced degree.
* Experience in the Consumer Electronics, Auto, OEMs, Telecom, E\-Commerce/Retail, Apps, Ads, Gaming, or Technology industries.
* Experience working with C\-level executives and cross\-functionally across multiple levels of management.
* Experience managing agreements or partnerships.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master's degree in a related field.
* Experience in CTV advertising ecosystem.
* Knowledge of digital advertising monetization in video, mobile and display with Google solutions.
* Ability to adapt to ambiguity and thrive in a rapidly changing environment.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Media and Entertainment team within Global Partnerships works with Google's largest Media partners to drive revenue and profitability through Google's platforms, products, and insights. The team focuses on current and future revenue opportunities for our partners by building trusted\-advisor relationships with C\-Suite and senior executives at partner organizations, is deeply knowledgeable about the industry that the partner operates in, and by thinking with an entrepreneurial spirit to help drive new revenue opportunities and areas of focus for the partner and Google.


In this role, you will help grow the relationships with the most strategic media partners by helping them set\-up and optimize their use of the Google Ad Manager (GAM) platform to drive new and existing programmatic business opportunities. You will look to help the partners grow business across all platforms (app, web, etc.), with an emphasis on CTV.
You will work closely with other members of the account team and cross\-functional Google teams to support the day\-to\-day management and up\-selling across their book of business. The Connected TV Inventory and Campaign Specialist is also the key Google Ad Manager product expert, providing training, implementation support, business optimization, sales support and strategic consulting to the partner.


The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product\-enabling partnerships, go\-to\-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $112000 \- $161000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Act as Google Ad Manager platform programmatic expert for Media Partners, providing specialized support at any stage including implementation, day\-to\-day questions and business strategy.
* Build and maintain business relationships for Google Ad Manager partners through close collaboration with partner account owners of all levels of seniority on a daily basis.
* Contribute to the growth and strategic direction of Google Ad Manager’s partners, products, and services as it relates to growing the book of business.
* Project manage time\-sensitive escalations related to business performance changes, product issues and challenges specific to a given partner.
* Deeply understand partner needs and opportunities for growth and upsell on existing business.

**Description**


This is an Institutional Account Manager position in a startup Pharma organization being built to launch a cardiovascular product in the critical care space. Reporting to the Syneos Health Area Business Director, the Account Manager will be responsible for engaging key stakeholders within complex hospital accounts, institutional systems and integrated delivery networks (IDNs).

**Responsibilities:**

* Maximize relationships with key academic institutions, IDNs and GPOs and leverage these relationships to generate increased demand and access for the product by targeting appropriate prescribers and decision influencers within the hospital.
* Partner with health systems to influence heads of departments, service line leaders, RNs, floor directors, and hospital pharmacy to secure formulary access and pull through of product utilization in the Hospital.
* Increase adoption and pull through of institutional/GPO contracts.
* Partner with administrators within health systems to remove barriers to appropriate use of product.
* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross\-functional discipline is critical. Cross\-functional partners may consist of Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources to determine strategies and tactics for business decision\-making.
* Demonstrate account\-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.). Build relationships in institutions aligned with customer segmentation.
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Develop a complete understanding of the health care delivery system within each assigned customer, including the physician hierarchy, key pharmacy personnel, clinical nursing staff, etc.
* Collaboratively build account plans with field colleagues and leadership, that will increase demand and patient care.
* Develop deep product and competitor knowledge and understanding of local and regional market trends.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in required training and development programs.
* Maintain adherence and compliance with all corporate, industry policies and procedures.

**Requirements:**

* BA/BS degree required.
* 5\+ years pharmaceutical/biotech sales experience.
* 2\+ years cardiovascular sales experience in the Hospital setting is required.
* Hospital/Institutional experience highly preferred.
* Knowledge of formulary approval process and driving formulary approvals is preferred.
* Must live within territory or within territory boundaries.
* Proven track record of success in a high science competitive selling environment.
* Ability to identify key decision makers, develop positive relationships and strong customer dedication.
* Self\-starter, highly motivated to succeed.
* Strong communication, business analytics and account management skills.
* Ability to work independently or in a team environment.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $155,000 to $170,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Here, the work is challenging, and the pace is exhilarating. By joining one of our commercial teams, you’re empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy that you need. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Syneos Health has launched more sales teams in the last 5 years across all major therapeutic areas than the top 25 pharma companies combined. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

  

At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. jobs.title: Social Media Manager - LA [Bilingual in Korean]
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Social Media Manager**

**Location:** Los Angeles, CA  

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  

**Compensation:** $30–$40 per hour, DOE  

**Experience:** 3–5\+ years preferred


About the Brands


We are a growing fashion and lifestyle company seeking a creative, fashion\-driven, and results\-oriented **Social Media Manager** to lead the social media presence and growth of our brands:


About the Role


We are looking for a hands\-on Social Media Manager who understands fashion, social media culture, content creation, brand storytelling, and performance\-driven growth.


This is not a role focused solely on scheduling posts. The ideal candidate will take ownership of each brand's social media presence—from strategy and content planning to execution, community engagement, influencer coordination, paid social support, analytics, and growth.


You will work closely with our Design and E\-Commerce teams while taking primary ownership of social media strategy and day\-to\-day execution across multiple fashion and lifestyle brands.

 **Job Description** **Social Media Strategy \& Brand Management**

* Develop and execute distinct social media strategies for multiple fashion and lifestyle brands.
* Establish and maintain a clear, consistent social identity, voice, and visual direction for each brand.
* Create and manage monthly and weekly social media content calendars.
* Identify relevant fashion, lifestyle, cultural, and social media trends and translate them into brand\-appropriate content.

**Content Creation \& Execution**

* Plan and manage content across Instagram, Reels, Stories, TikTok, Facebook, and other relevant platforms.
* Create engaging short\-form content using available product, model, lifestyle, and behind\-the\-scenes assets.
* Coordinate with Design and E\-Commerce teams regarding new products, collections, seasonal campaigns, and key product launches.
* Write compelling, brand\-appropriate captions and social media copy.
* Coordinate product shoots and social content shoots as needed.
* Maintain a consistent and effective posting schedule across all brands.

**Community \& Influencer Management**

* Monitor and respond to comments, direct messages, tags, mentions, and other customer engagement.
* Build relationships with followers and strengthen each brand's online community.
* Identify and coordinate with influencers, creators, and micro\-influencers.
* Support product seeding, creator collaborations, and influencer marketing initiatives.
* Track creator and influencer performance.

**Growth \& Paid Social**

* Develop strategies to increase qualified followers, engagement, website traffic, and conversions.
* Collaborate with the E\-Commerce team on Instagram and Facebook advertising, boosted posts, and social media campaigns.
* Test creative concepts, audiences, formats, and messaging to improve campaign performance.
* Identify high\-performing organic content that may be expanded through paid promotion.

**Analytics \& Reporting**

* Track and analyze weekly and monthly social media KPIs, including:


	+ Follower growth
	+ Reach and impressions
	+ Engagement rate
	+ Reels and video views
	+ Website traffic
	+ Conversion and sales, when measurable
	+ Top\-performing products and content
* Prepare concise weekly social media performance reports.
* Provide actionable recommendations based on performance data and trends.

 **Qualifications** **Must bilingual in Korean**

* 3–5\+ years of hands\-on social media management experience, preferably within fashion, apparel, beauty, lifestyle, or consumer brands.
* Strong knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook/Meta, and emerging social media platforms.
* Strong understanding of fashion trends, lifestyle content, social media culture, and young consumer behavior.
* Demonstrated experience growing social media audiences and increasing engagement.
* Experience creating short\-form video content, particularly Instagram Reels and TikTok.
* Strong visual judgment and understanding of fashion merchandising and brand storytelling.
* Excellent written communication and caption\-writing skills.
* Ability to manage multiple brands and projects while maintaining strong organization and attention to detail.
* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of social media strategy and execution.


Preferred

* Experience with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, or similar content creation tools.
* Understanding of Meta Business Suite and Meta Ads Manager.
* Shopify or e\-commerce experience.
* Experience with influencer, creator, or affiliate marketing

 **Additional Information**  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Server / Social Media Specialist – Sports Bar
jobs.description:
Campus Billiards \& Sports Bar in Cypress is hiring a Server / Social Media Specialist for football season. This is one role with two jobs: serve the room, and own the bar’s football\-season social media.

You are on the floor serving and taking care of guests on NFL Sundays and Thursday nights. You are also the person in charge of all Campus social content during football — filming, appearing on camera, talking about the games, acting/modeling for TikToks, live\-streaming, editing, and posting.

This is not “take a few phone videos if you have time.” You are the content person for football season. Every Thursday \& Sunday.

If you only want to serve, do not apply. If you only want to film other people and never be on camera yourself, do not apply.

What you will do

Serving

* Serve shots, beer, hard cider, wine, cocktails, and food
* Keep service fast during football Sundays and Thursday nights
* Help sell shots and specialty drinks when the room is packed
* Learn our craft beer list and run the POS correctly
* Work as part of the floor team

Social media (you own this during football season)

* Create and post all football\-season content for Campus. Livestream
* Every shift, film and post a video of yourself talking about the sports of the day
* Appear on camera as talent — talking, acting, and modeling for TikToks and Reels
* Film the room, the screens, the crowd, the drinks, and the vibe
* Edit and post using CapCut and Canva
* Go live when asked
* Share Campus content on your own social accounts
* Help grow our following and bring more people through the door

Social media skills are required You must already be comfortable with:

* TikTok
* Instagram (Reels and edits)
* CapCut
* Being on camera yourself (talking\-head videos, acting, modeling)

Content is a core part of every shift, not extra work after you clock out.

Interview process Part of the interview is creating a TikTok. Applicants who move forward will film and edit a short on\-camera video in CapCut (Canva if needed). We are looking at personality on camera, comfort talking about sports, and how fast you can turn a clip around.

Required schedule (no exceptions) You must work both of the following every week for the full football season:

* Sunday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
* Thursday: 5:00 PM – 10:00 PM

Do not apply if you have vacations, weddings, concerts, trips, or other conflicts on these days. There is no schedule flexibility.

Requirements

* 21 or older
* Outgoing, reliable, and comfortable on a busy sports\-bar floor
* Comfortable on camera talking, acting, and modeling
* Comfortable creating and editing TikTok / Instagram content in CapCut and Canva
* Willing to use your own social accounts to share bar content
* Reliable transportation and on time for every shift
* Able to walk and stand for a full shift
* Pass a pre\-employment drug screen
* Willing to learn our craft beer selection

Bar or restaurant experience is a plus. Being good on camera and actually finishing content every shift matters more.

Pay $17/hour plus shared tip pool.

How to apply Apply on Indeed and include links to your Instagram and TikTok.

We look at those first.

Interviews start Saturday night. Qualified applicants will be contacted quickly.

Campus Billiards \& Sports Bar

9111 Valley View St \#107, Cypress, CA 90630

(714\) 952\-2731

Pay: From $17\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee discount

Work Location: In person

*Cultivating the American Dream* is the purpose that binds the Avanath team. At Avanath, every day is an opportunity to make a difference in someone's life. jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Abramson Labor Group is a client\-focused law firm dedicated to advocating for individuals in Employment Law, Workers' Compensation, and Personal Injury cases. We focus on representing both single plaintiffs and class action clients, guiding them through every stage of their case from pre\-litigation to resolution. Our firm is dedicated to delivering client\-focused, results\-oriented representation through a team of skilled, passionate, and dedicated legal professionals.

 **Job Description**  

We are seeking a highly capable, professional, and proactive Executive Assistant to provide dedicated support to our Workers' Compensation Partner.


This is a fully on\-site, full\-time position based in our Burbank office. The right candidate will be a sharp, solutions\-oriented professional who thrives in a fast\-paced legal environment, handles competing priorities without stress, goes the distance to ensure everything gets handled, and serves as a trusted extension of the Partner across both business and personal administrative matters.


No workers' compensation experience is required. What we need is someone who brings exceptional judgment, initiative, and a genuine commitment to getting things done.

**Key Responsibilities:**


Calendar \& Schedule Management:

* Manage and maintain the Partner's complex calendar, including scheduling meetings, court deadlines, appointments, and personal commitments
* Proactively anticipate scheduling conflicts and resolve them before they arise
* Coordinate with internal staff and external parties to confirm, reschedule, and prepare for all engagements


Communication \& Correspondence

* Serve as the primary point of contact for the Partner's inbox triage, route, draft, and respond to emails on his behalf with appropriate tone and professionalism
* Screen and prioritize phone calls and messages, escalating urgent matters appropriately
* Draft polished internal and external communications, memos, and correspondence


Liaison \& Internal Coordination

* Act as the communication bridge between the Partner and senior attorneys, staff, and external partners
* Relay information, gather updates, and follow through on action items on behalf of the Partner
* Build strong working relationships across the firm's team while maintaining strict confidentiality


Project Management \& Follow\-Through

* Track open projects, deadlines, and deliverables across multiple workstreams; proactively follow up to ensure nothing falls through the cracks
* Assist in coordinating special projects, firm initiatives, and business development activities
* Prepare meeting agendas, briefing documents, and summaries as needed


Technology \& Systems

* Utilize firm software, CRM tools, and productivity platforms to manage information and workflow efficiently
* Quickly learn new platforms and tools; proactively suggest tech\-enabled improvements where applicable
* Support document preparation, file management, and data organization


Personal \& Administrative Support

* Assist with personal tasks and errands as directed, including running local errands (valid driver's license required)
* Manage travel arrangements, reservations, and logistics
* Handle sensitive and confidential matters with the utmost discretion

  

**Qualifications** **Required:**

* Exceptional organizational and time management skills with a demonstrated ability to juggle competing priorities without dropping the ball
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Valid California driver's license and reliable personal vehicle
* Ability to exercise independent judgment and take initiative in a fast\-moving environment
* Tech\-savvy with proficiency in Microsoft Office and the ability to learn new platforms quickly

**Preferred:**

* Experience in an executive assistant, chief of staff, or senior administrative role supporting C\-suite or senior leadership
* Experience with project management tools and CRM platforms
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) a plus

  

**Additional Information**  

This is a full\-time, in\-person position based in Burbank, CA. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative work environment that values career advancement, ongoing learning, and professional development.


If you are a motivated, goal\-oriented, and strategic leader with a passion for identifying top talent and building powerful industry connections, we encourage you to apply today.


All your information will be kept confidential in accordance with EEO guidelines.

**Benefits**


Our law firm offers eligible employees a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage. We also provide eligible employees with flexible time off plans, including Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays.

**Department**


Worker's Compensation

**Employment Type**


Full Time

**Location**


California

**Workplace type**


On\-site

**Compensation**


$75,000 \- $85,000 annual salary depending on experience
