jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

  

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR \& IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.

  

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third\-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

This is a high\-activity, outbound Sales Development role. You’ll be responsible for creating a sales pipeline by researching target accounts, reaching prospects through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels, and booking qualified meetings for Account Executives.

  

It is a focused top\-of\-funnel role for someone who is energized by prospecting, fast feedback loops, daily activity goals, and a team environment where performance is visible and celebrated. This is not an inbound or full\-cycle sales role.

  

You’ll learn Rippling’s full platform, understand the operational pain points our customers face, and build the foundation for a long\-term career in sales. Successful SDRs typically spend time in\-seat developing core prospecting, discovery, objection\-handling, and territory\-management skills before furthering their sales career.

 ***(This is a hybrid role and you will be required to be in the office 3x per week in San Francisco, CA)***

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Research target companies, personas, business triggers, and operational pain points to identify high\-quality prospecting opportunities
* Prospect into target accounts using phone, email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement tools
* Own a high\-volume outbound motion, including daily call blocks, email follow\-ups, account research, and multi\-touch sequences
* Work toward clear daily and weekly activity expectations, including roughly 80–100 calls and 40–50 emails per day, depending on territory priorities and team guidance
* Qualify prospects using defined criteria and schedule high\-quality meetings for Account Executives
* Partner closely with Account Executives on territory strategy, account prioritization, messaging, and follow\-ups
* Participate actively in weekly enablement sessions, team call reviews, and manager coaching; apply feedback quickly to improve your messaging, objection handling, and overall prospecting effectiveness
* Maintain accurate records in Salesforce and keep outreach, account, and prospect data clean
* Leverage tools like Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo, and dialer technology to execute efficiently

**Qualifications**
------------------

* BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience
* A high sense of urgency and genuine interest in a sales career
* Strong communication skills, especially over the phone and in concise, written outreach
* Coachability \- you can take feedback, apply it quickly, and improve from one call to the next
* Curiosity and initiative \- you ask good questions, seek context, and look for ways to get better without waiting to be told
* Resilience and consistency in a high\-activity prospecting environment
* Comfort working toward measurable goals in a competitive, team\-oriented setting
* Ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with sales, marketing, and other teams
* Prior sales, customer\-facing, athletics, or competitive team experience is helpful, but not required

 **What success looks like**
In your first 30 days, you’ll focus on onboarding, product knowledge, sales methodology, tools, messaging, and understanding Rippling’s customers.  

By month two, you’ll begin ramping into live prospecting, building activity consistency, and working toward partial quota expectations.  

By month three, you should be operating at full ramp expectations, managing daily outbound activity, booking qualified meetings, and showing consistent improvement through coaching and repetition.  

Longer term, success in this role means building the skills and track record to grow your sales career at Rippling \- whether that path is toward Account Executive, SDR leadership, or another go\-to\-market role. **Why join Rippling*** You’ll sell a product that solves real operational problems for companies \- not a narrow point solution
* You’ll learn how businesses run across HR, IT, Finance, payroll, benefits, devices, apps, and more
* You’ll join a fast\-paced, high\-performance sales environment with strong coaching, clear goals, and room to grow
* You’ll be part of a collaborative SDR team that values healthy competition, accountability, and continuous improvement

You’ll get exposure to a rapidly expanding platform, including newer product areas such as AI and data  
*

jobs.title: Executive Operations Associate, Office of the CEO
jobs.description:
**About Distyl AI**
===================

Distyl is an applied AI technology company partnering with the world’s most ambitious institutions to rearchitect critical operations for the frontier of AI. Our customers include the largest companies in telecom, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, consumer goods, and global social organizations.  

  

We research and deploy technologies that power AI\-native operations — both for our partners and for Distyl itself. Our work spans research into self\-constructing systems, the development of the most reliable execution of AI systems, and products that transform mission\-critical workflows. As a result, Distyl's technologies affect some of the world's largest operations — from hundreds of millions of consumer interactions to tens of millions of supply chain transactions and millions of patient journeys.  

  

Distyl is backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Coatue, DST Global, and the board\-members of 20\+ F500s.


**Why This Role Exists**
------------------------


Distyl’s CEO operates at a fast pace across Fortune 500 customers, investors, board members, candidates, partners, and the press, often across multiple cities in the same week. Keeping that work moving requires someone who can manage critical details while also solving unfamiliar problems with speed and judgment.


This role is equal parts executive support and business problem\-solving. You will coordinate complex logistics, manage priorities, build relationships, and take ambiguous requests from idea to completion. You will not simply manage activity around the CEO; you will help the entire operation run better.


This is an opportunity for an ambitious professional to learn how a high\-growth AI company is built from inside the Office of the CEO. You will receive significant exposure and you will earn increasing responsibility by executing exceptionally well, demonstrating sound judgment, and consistently taking work off the CEO’s plate.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Turn requests into outcomes.** Take ownership of unfamiliar, multi\-step needs—whether securing an urgent international visa, preparing for an important meeting, researching a business question, or coordinating a strategic project. Determine the path forward, involve the right people, and drive the work to completion.

**Create leverage for the CEO.** Manage scheduling, travel, meeting preparation, personal logistics, and follow\-up with precision. Maintain a clear view of priorities and commitments so important details do not get dropped.

**Deliver exceptional external experiences.** Ensure that candidates, customers, investors, board members, and partners experience thoughtful communication and flawless coordination. When plans change, respond calmly and protect both the relationship and the CEO’s time.

**Help develop important relationships.** Research stakeholders, identify paths to valuable introductions, coordinate thoughtful outreach, and follow up persistently. Learn when to keep pursuing an objective, when to try a different approach, and when to recommend moving on.

**Strengthen the Office of the CEO.** Create trackers, workflows, briefing materials, daily priority summaries, meeting\-preparation standards, and follow\-up systems. Identify recurring friction and build a better process.

**Work across the company.** Coordinate with founders’ associates, executives, employees, and external vendors. Communicate clearly, establish ownership, and keep projects moving even when no one reports directly to you.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* A recent graduate or professional with approximately 0–3 years of experience.
* A strong record of academic, professional, entrepreneurial, or extracurricular achievement.
* High agency and resourcefulness, you try multiple paths to solve a problem rather than dropping the task when the first approach fails.
* Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and follow\-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* The judgment to handle confidential information and interact professionally with senior executives.
* Comfort moving between strategic projects and hands\-on logistics without viewing either as beneath you.
* Intellectual curiosity and the ability to learn unfamiliar subjects quickly.
* A low\-ego, service\-oriented approach combined with ambition and a desire to grow.
* Comfort operating in an environment where priorities move quickly and the playbook is still being written.
* Fluency with AI tools and an instinct for using technology to improve your work.
* Ability to work from our San Francisco office.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* The CEO spends more time on the company’s highest\-value priorities.
* Important commitments and follow\-ups are completed without reminders.
* Complex logistics run smoothly, even when plans change.
* Stakeholders experience Distyl as thoughtful, responsive, and exceptionally well organized.
* Ambiguous requests become completed outcomes.
* The systems supporting the Office of the CEO become increasingly proactive and scalable.
* As trust develops, you take ownership of progressively broader projects and responsibilities.

**Why This Opportunity Is Different**
-------------------------------------


This is not a conventional Executive Assistant position, nor is it a purely strategic role. It is a hands\-on opportunity for someone who wants direct exposure to the decisions, relationships, and operating challenges behind a rapidly growing AI company.


The right person will be equally willing to solve an urgent travel problem, prepare the CEO for a consequential meeting, improve an internal system, or drive a cross\-functional project. No task is too small when it creates leverage, and no problem is too ambiguous to begin solving.

**What We Offer**
=================

* The base salary range for this role is $100K\

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

**About the role**

  

ElevenLabs moves fast \- and behind every high\-performing leader is someone who makes sure nothing slips. This is a high\-trust, hands\-on role for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, holds themselves to a high standard, and takes genuine pride in making their lead's life easier \- down to the small, considered details that others overlook.

  

You'll be the operational backbone for senior leadership \- managing calendars, coordinating across time zones, handling logistics, and owning the day\-to\-day administrative tasks that let leadership focus on what matters most.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own calendars and time allocation for finance leadership team, making trade\-off calls independently against stated priorities
* Prepare executives for every meeting: pre\-reads, context, and the decision needed \- including board and investor sessions
* Capture actions out of meetings and chase them to completion
* Triage executive inboxes and draft correspondence
* Automate the mechanical parts of the role \- briefing prep, triage, scheduling, recurring reporting
* Run discrete projects: board logistics, executive travel, offsites, and the finance team's operating cadence

**Requirements**

* Experience supporting multiple senior executives in a high\-velocity environment
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities, shifting timelines, and multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, from senior executives and partners to vendors and office guests
* Proven judgment and problem\-solving skills
* Fluency with AI tools and a track record of automating your own work \- come ready to show what you've built
* High emotional intelligence and discretion \- trusted with sensitive information
* Fluency in English

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: E-Commerce Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Location:** Brooklyn, NY  

**Schedule:** Full\-time, on\-site \| Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM  

**Salary:** $60,000–$70,000  

**Reports to:** Director of E\-Commerce Operations

**The Role**
------------


We are looking for an organized, analytical, and dependable **E\-Commerce Operations Coordinator** to support our growing e\-commerce business across Amazon (1P), Walmart, Target\+, Wayfair, and other major marketplaces.


This is an entry\-level role with the opportunity to grow into meaningful responsibility. You will help manage projects, product listings, reporting, inventory, and cross\-team follow\-up. We will train the right person, but we expect strong attention to detail, a willingness to learn, and consistent ownership.


You’ll get a front\-row view of what it takes to operate a nine\-figure e\-commerce business and gain hands\-on experience with the systems, processes, and teams that keep it running behind the scenes.


For someone who is early in their career and interested in e\-commerce, operations, analytics, or marketplace management, this is an opportunity to learn the business from the ground up while working directly with an experienced e\-commerce team.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Track projects, deadlines, action items, and follow\-ups across internal and overseas teams.
* Create, update, and maintain accurate product listings across multiple e\-commerce marketplaces.
* Review product pricing, images, descriptions, specifications, and other listing information for accuracy.
* Analyze sales, inventory, and product performance reports to help identify trends and potential issues.
* Support inventory planning and help ensure appropriate product availability across marketplaces.
* Assist with new product launches and marketplace setup.
* Maintain spreadsheets, reports, trackers, and process documentation.
* Research listing, inventory, pricing, and operational issues and help coordinate solutions.
* Communicate updates and follow up with team members to keep projects moving.
* Help identify opportunities to improve processes, reporting, and day\-to\-day e\-commerce operations.
* Support the Director of E\-Commerce Operations with additional projects and initiatives as needed.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.
* Analytical and comfortable working with numbers, data, and spreadsheets.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
* Reliable, proactive, and able to follow through on assignments.
* Able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable working and communicating with multiple teams.
* Quick to learn new systems, processes, and technology.
* Able to research problems, think critically, and work toward solutions.
* Comfortable working independently while also collaborating as part of a team.

**Experience**
--------------


Previous e\-commerce or marketplace experience is helpful, but **not required**.


Experience with Amazon Vendor Central, Walmart, Target\+, Wayfair, or similar platforms is a plus, but we are willing to train someone who demonstrates strong organizational skills, analytical ability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.

**Who Will Succeed in This Role?**
----------------------------------


This position is a great fit for someone who is early in their career and wants more than just a traditional entry\-level job. You may not know everything about e\-commerce yet—and that's okay.


We're looking for someone who enjoys figuring things out, notices when something doesn't look right, follows through without needing constant reminders, and isn't afraid to ask questions and learn.


As you develop your knowledge of our marketplaces, products, systems, and operations, you'll have the opportunity to take on greater ownership and broader operational responsibility.


If you're organized, curious, comfortable with data, and excited to learn how a large e\-commerce business operates behind the scenes, we'd love to hear from you.

The Development Operations Coordinator provides essential administrative and operational support to iMentor’s Development team. Reporting to the Vice President of Philanthropy \& Development Operations, this role is responsible for maintaining accurate fundraising data, processing philanthropic gifts, supporting donor acknowledgments and reporting, and ensuring that Development staff have the timely and reliable information they need to effectively manage donor relationships and fundraising activity.



The Coordinator will work extensively within Salesforce and other fundraising platforms to maintain strong data integrity and execute the day\-to\-day processes that keep the Development department running smoothly. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys detailed database work, takes pride in accuracy and organization, and finds satisfaction in providing excellent service and operational support to colleagues and donors.



The Coordinator will work extensively within Salesforce and other fundraising platforms, and will also serve as a close partner to external relations leaders in building strong team culture and coordinating department\-level meetings and communications.


### **Gift Processing and Administration**


* Process philanthropic gifts and pledges accurately and promptly, including gifts received by check, EFT, stock, donor\-advised fund, matching gift, and through other giving vehicles.
* Maintain complete and accurate gift, pledge, payment, and donor information in Salesforce.
* Prepare and process timely donor acknowledgment letters, receipts, and other gift\-related correspondence.
* Maintain accurate pledge schedules and payment information and support relationship managers with upcoming pledge payment reminders and follow\-up.
* Ensure corporate matching and volunteer donations and other specialized gift types are recorded accurately and include the appropriate donor and organizational information.
* Produce regular gift reports and documentation, work closely with Finance to research and resolve gift discrepancies, and support accurate reconciliation of philanthropic revenue.
* Identify and support opportunities to improve gift processing, acknowledgment, and reconciliation workflows.
* Process Development team invoices, expense documentation, and American Express reports.
### **CRM and Data Integrity**


* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date donor, prospect, organization, gift, opportunity, contact, and engagement information in Salesforce.
* Conduct routine data\-quality reviews and cleanup to identify missing, duplicate, outdated, or inconsistent constituent information.
* Ensure relationship managers have current contact information, giving history, engagement records, and other relevant data needed to effectively manage donor relationships.
* Help troubleshoot routine Salesforce questions for Development team members.
* Partner with appropriate internal staff when technical Salesforce changes or more complex database support are required.
### **Reporting and Development Team Support**


* Generate recurring and ad hoc fundraising reports, lists, data exports, and invitation, solicitation, mailing, stewardship, donor, and prospect lists based on team needs.
* Monitor shared Development communications, including the department’s general email inbox, and ensure inquiries are routed and addressed appropriately.
* Provide administrative support for department\-wide projects and activities in a timely and service\-oriented manner as needed.
* Conduct preliminary donor and prospect research and prepare profiles on an ad hoc basis to support relationship managers and organizational leadership.
### **Events \& Campaign Administration**

* Support the Development team with other administrative event and campaign needs as assigned.
### **Qualifications**

* Experience working regularly in a CRM or database environment; Salesforce experience strongly preferred.

* Strong attention to detail, excellent organizational skills, and a demonstrated commitment to data accuracy.
* Strong customer\-service orientation and genuine enjoyment of supporting colleagues and responding to requests thoughtfully and efficiently.
* Ability to work carefully with confidential donor and financial information and exercise sound judgment and discretion.
* Comfort working with Microsoft Excel and other common office and productivity tools and ability to learn and work within fundraising and technology platforms such as Salesforce and GoFundMe Pro.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, reliability, follow\-through, and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.

**Job Description**
-------------------


Transportation Planning and Management (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  

  

The Office of Livable Streets (OLS) is tasked with prioritizing strategic planning, community engagement, research, policy, design, implementation, and long\-term management. Their goal is to create streets that are livable, supporting safety, accessibility, inclusion, resiliency, active modes, community cohesion, and economic vitality citywide. Additionally, they aim to enhance New York City's pedestrian, bicycle, and micromobility networks, providing comfortable, connected, green, and reliable transportation options across the five boroughs. They place special emphasis on Priority Investment Areas, mode shift, and reimagining streets. The office also develops innovative new programs, design typologies, project delivery, and analysis tools to meet the demands of a rapidly changing population with evolving needs and technologies.
  

  

The Cycling \& Micromobility Unit is responsible for the nation's largest network of on\-street bicycle facilities (1,200\+ lane\-miles), enhancing street safety for all users, and increasing bike ridership in the five boroughs. The team's focus is the innovative redesign of city streets to expand and improve the bike network, with emphasis on improving connectivity between neighborhoods, increasing access to safe bicycle infrastructure across the city, and creating a more equitable transportation network that serves all New Yorkers.
  

The Cycling \& Micromobility unit seeks to hire an Operations Coordinator to support the launch and implementation of the Secure Bike Program (SBP). Over the next five years, NYC DOT will install 500 secure bike parking facilities, creating thousands of safe, convenient bicycle parking spaces across New York City. This initiative will make cycling more accessible and practical by supporting ownership of a wide range of bicycles, including cargo bikes, adaptive bikes, and UL\-certified e\-bikes.
  

Under the supervision of the Senior Program Manager, the Operations Coordinator will play a key role in the deployment and operation of SBP facilities citywide. The candidate will evaluate existing site conditions and document findings to identify technically feasible locations for SBP installations, review installation plans and site layouts to ensure accuracy and compliance with project requirements, coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to address site\-specific issues and support successful facility deployment, and provide general support for project planning and implementation. The candidate will perform post\-installation inspections to verify facilities are installed according to approved plans and specifications, conduct routine field inspections to monitor facility conditions and ensure compliance with maintenance and service requirements, document inspection findings, and coordinate corrective actions as needed. The candidate will maintain accurate records of site assessments, installations, inspections, and operational activities using program databases and tracking systems, assist with performance monitoring and reporting related to facility operations and contractor service compliance, and support pre\-installation notifications and other administrative activities associated with project delivery. The candidate will support community engagement activities related to the Secure Bike Program, prepare work orders based upon field conditions, assist with inquiries and support communication efforts related to SBP, and perform additional duties and special projects related to the implementation and operation of the program, as assigned.
  

We are looking for a detail\-oriented, proactive, and collaborative professional with strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills. The candidate should be comfortable working both independently and as part of a team and demonstrate a willingness to conduct fieldwork year\-round while traveling by bicycle, on foot, or via public transit.
  

The Department of Transportation’s (DOT) mission is to provide for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods in the City of New York and to maintain and enhance the transportation infrastructure crucial to the economic vitality and quality of life of our primary customers, City residents. DOT is an equal opportunity employer, committed to recruiting and maintaining a diverse workforce in an open and inclusive environment.
  

  

Preferred Skills
  

Professional experience in design, engineering, or planning or a related field. Demonstrate interest in cycling and New York City’s built environment. Proficiency in MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint is strongly desired.

### **About Veho**

  

Veho’s mission is to power the future of commerce by making shopping, shipping and returns seamless for everyone.

  

We are building a modern, end\-to\-end logistics infrastructure designed entirely for the ever\-evolving needs of ecommerce brands and everyday consumers.  



Powered by next\-generation technology and a vertically integrated supply chain, Veho gives brands and their customers unprecedented control over their deliveries and removes the pain from the ecommerce post\-purchase experience. jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
### **Come join our Customer Success team!**

 **High velocity, high trust, and high impact with a will to win.**


If those words resonate deeply with you, this could be your next career move. We're seeking someone who leads with humility, pursues audacious goals, and is motivated by meaningful impact on people and the world.


At FutureFit AI, our core mission is to help more people get to better jobs faster and cheaper, with a specific focus on those facing barriers to opportunity. Our work helps resolve the growing issue of economic inequality, ensuring that no one is left behind in the future of work. Our AI\-powered platform brings efficiency and insight to workforce development, replacing outdated systems and unlocking human potential at scale.


Ready to make an impact? Apply today.

*Important note: Data shows that men typically apply when meeting 3/10 requirements, while women often wait until it's 10/10\. We encourage you to apply if you see a strong (not necessarily perfect) fit.*

**Your Role**
-------------


We are seeking a strategic, highly consultative leader to guide complex workforce SaaS technology implementations and help our customers translate ambitious workforce goals into effective, scalable solutions throughout the customer lifecycle.


In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders across government, education, and industry. You will lead customers through platform design and implementation, helping them define their strategy, map workflows and user journeys, make critical program and technology decisions, and successfully launch and scale their platforms. You will also own ongoing account management through renewal and expansion.


You will also serve as a key bridge between our customers and our Product and Engineering teams. You will relay customer goals and operational needs internally, while also communicating product capabilities in an accessible, audience\-appropriate language externally.


This role is well suited for someone with experience in management consulting, workforce development leadership, government or education technology, or strategic enterprise customer success.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### ***Lead complex customer implementations***

* Lead the end\-to\-end implementation of complex workforce technology solutions.
* Develop implementation strategies, work plans, decision frameworks, timelines, and governance structures.
* Facilitate discovery sessions to understand customers’ goals, policies, programs, stakeholders, technology environments, and operational constraints.
* Be able to lead discussions on current\- and future\-state workflows, user journeys, service\-delivery models, and data flows.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and unresolved decisions, and proactively drive them toward resolution.

### ***Advise and engage executive stakeholders***

* Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors, program leaders, technical stakeholders, and frontline teams.
* Lead executive presentations, steering committee meetings, strategic planning sessions, and implementation workshops.
* Communicate complex information clearly and concisely through presentations, written recommendations, status updates, and decision documents.
* Help customers connect platform decisions to their broader workforce, economic\-development, and organizational strategies.
* Navigate competing stakeholder priorities and build alignment across complex customer organizations and partners.

### ***Serve as the bridge between customers and Product***

* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Design to clarify customer needs, evaluate potential solutions, and communicate tradeoffs.
* Provide customers with clear updates on integrations, data exchanges, configuration work, and other technical deliverables.
* Explain technical concepts to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise.
* Represent the customer perspective while balancing individual requests with scalable product strategy.
* Identify recurring customer needs and market trends that should inform the product roadmap.

### ***Provide workforce expertise and strategic insight***

* Develop a strong understanding of each customer’s workforce ecosystem, target populations, programs, partners, and policy environment.
* Stay informed about workforce policy, labor\-market trends, funding developments, economic conditions, and other external factors that may affect customers.

* Consistently meet or exceed activity and performance goals.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary plus commission opportunities.
* Opportunity for professional growth and development.
* Ongoing sales training and mentorship.
* Friendly, collaborative, and supportive work environment.
* Exposure to leading technology, cybersecurity, cloud, and AI solutions.

  


Requirements:  

  

**Qualifications:**

**Core Qualifications:**

* 2\+ years of customer service, sales, business development, or related customer\-facing experience.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to build rapport and establish trust with prospective clients.
* Self\-motivated with a strong desire to achieve goals and drive results.
* Comfortable making outbound calls and engaging with new contacts.
* Strong organizational, time management, and follow\-up skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment.

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for **making a difference for small business** in your community? Are you looking for a career with **unlimited income potential**? Is **company culture** important to you? Or maybe you have been thinking about switching career paths and moving into sales?

**NFIB was chosen as a Glassdoor Top 50 Best Places to Work.** A sales career with NFIB provides **money, mission, mobility,** and a culture that fosters teamwork and collaboration. Whether you have some sales experience or are new to sales, NFIB will set you up for success with best\-in\-class training. **A career with NFIB provides a flexible work/life balance while still maintaining full\-time effort in the field.**  

We are seeking individuals who are results\-focused, with an **entrepreneurial spirit**, and exceptional work ethic to prospect, conduct face\-to\-face cold calls, and enroll new members.


***What’s in it for you:**** **W\-2 with full benefits** (medical, dental, vision, matching 401k, and more) \- **eligible after 30 days**
* **Up to 13 weeks** (1,000/wk) **performance\-based training pay** (or commission, whichever is greater)
* **Production\-based weekly commissions, monthly \& quarterly bonuses**
* **Yearly average compensation: $80,000 \- $200,000**
* **40%** of our sales force **earns 6\-figures** with the **top 10%** earning **over 200k**
* **UNCAPPED earning potential** (Straight Commission)
* **Monthly Mileage reimbursement**

***Who we are*****:**

**NFIB is the most trusted advocate for free enterprise**, promoting and protecting the rights of any individual to own, operate, and grow their business. **NFIB's advocacy has a profound impact on shaping public policies** by influencing


decision\-makers, raising awareness, and mobilizing public support. NFIB membership is the mechanism for small business owners to actively contribute to the development of policies that align with their values and concerns. **NFIB has been fighting for independent business owners** for over 80 years. We are the **Voice of Small Business** in Washington, D.C., and in all 50 state capitals. **NFIB is a nonprofit, nonpartisan, and member driven** organization.

  

We educate small business owners through in\-person prospecting (no appointment setting) using NFIB's success\-proven verbatim sales presentation. This is a hunter/closer sales position using an assumptive one\-call close with no account management after the sale. ***What you will be responsible for:**** Meeting small business owners through in\-person prospecting (no appointment setting)
* Memorizing and utilizing NFIB’s proven 5\-minute verbatim sales presentation
* Building quick rapport and delivering an engaging presentation
* Overcoming objections and closing the sale

Processing payment on the spot  
* 

  

***Requirements to win in this role:**** Strong work ethic
* Grit and relentless perseverance
* Self\-starter and ability to stick with a structured, proven sales model
* Desire for ongoing learning
* Quick\-witted, adaptable, and strategic
* Passion for the success of small business
* Sales experience **AND/OR** transferable skills
* Intermediate technical skills


A career with NFIB means being part of a team of truly extraordinary people working to promote and protect small business. You will be impacting your community while taking advantage of our competitive compensation, ongoing training, incentives, and generous benefits package. **Learn more about the NFIB’s culture here:** www.nfib.com/careers


Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.description:
Inizio Engage has a long\-standing partnership with a leading Biotechnology company, across Commercial, Patient Solutions and Medical Affairs businesses.


Inizio Engage has partnered with Eisai. We are seeking a performance\-driven Pharmaceutical Field Sales Representative with a strong background in primary care and pharmaceutical sales. This role builds strategic territory business plans, understands customer needs, and drives sales performance for key neurology\-focused targets.


This is your opportunity to join Inizio Engage and represent a top biopharmaceutical company!

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**


We believe great people deserve great support—at work and beyond. That’s why we offer a rewards experience designed to help you thrive personally, professionally, and financially:

* Competitive pay that recognizes your experience, expertise, and impact
* Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage; accrued paid time off; 401(k) with company match; disability and life insurance; and paid maternity and paternity leave
* Company\-paid holidays so you can rest, recharge, and focus on what matters most
* Recognition programs, contests, and awards that celebrate your contributions
* Continuous growth opportunities through learning, leadership development, and career advancement support
* A collaborative culture where your ideas are valued and your work makes a difference


We’re also proud to be recognized for creating an exceptional employee experience:

* Best Place to Work in BioPharma — 2022, 2023, 2025
* Certified Great Place to Work® — 2021, 2023, 2025, 2026


Learn more: https://www.greatplacetowork.com/certified\-company/7003732  

  

**What will you be doing?**

* Demonstrate deep marketplace, therapeutic, product and disease expertise based on a thorough understanding of scientific principles and clinical data, including mechanism of action, indications, efficacy, safety, etc.
* Understand and apply knowledge of the healthcare industry, market trends, regulations, and the neurology market access environment—including payer landscape, reimbursement processes, and patient pathways.
* Build and maintain strong professional relationships with physicians, HCPs, office staff, and other key stakeholders.
* Develop and execute territory business plans based on strategic analysis of market conditions and customer needs.
* Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams to align on goals and deliver results.
* Ask strategic, insightful questions to uncover customer needs and tailor solutions that improve the lives of patients.

**What do you need for this position?**

* Bachelor’s degree required
* 2\+ years of pharmaceutical sales experience required
* Prior experience in Primary Care Provider (PCP) sales required
* Neurology experience a strong plus
* Proven track record of sales success
* Strong interpersonal communication and relationship\-building skills

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Emerald**


Emerald’s talented and experienced teams grow our customers’ businesses 365 days a year with products that create connections, deliver content, and drive commerce. We produce over 140 annual events, create and deliver content through print and digital channels, and power commerce through our seamlessly integrated in\-person and digital platforms and channels. For more information, please visit http://www.emeraldx.com.

  

Emerald is looking for a high\-energy Business Development pro to help grow revenue across our portfolio of trade shows and conferences. You’ll be the person who finds the right companies to talk to, starts the conversation, and qualifies opportunities for our Account Executives to close.

  

If you like digging into research, testing what messaging works, and using tools like Gong and Salesforce to build a pipeline, you’ll fit right in. You’ll help create pipeline through modern outbound prospecting — combining research, signal\-based targeting, and consultative outreach. This is a fast\-paced, “learn by doing” role with clear coaching, measurable goals, and a strong path into an Account Executive career track. This role combines research, signal\-based targeting, and consultative outreach.

 **This position will be based out of our Alpharetta, GA or New York City, NY office.**

 **Why this role matters:** You’ll create the early\-stage pipeline—turning target accounts into real conversations and qualified opportunities that become pipeline and revenue.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Research net\-new exhibitor and sponsor accounts using ZoomInfo industry intelligence, and signal\-based prospecting (intent, trigger events, engagement signals).
* Build targeted lists and run multi\-threaded outreach cadences (email, phone, social) while keeping clean notes and next steps in Salesforce.
* Qualify prospects through short discovery conversations—understanding business pain, priorities, stakeholders, decisions process, and timing so we focus on high\-potential opportunities.
* Create personalized outreach that connects a prospect’s business goals to the value of Emerald’s events (ROI, audience, leads, brand visibility).
* Partner closely with Account Executives for a smooth handoff—sharing research, key contacts, conversation notes, and recommended next steps.
* Collaborate with Marketing and attendee teams to share feedback on lead quality, personas, and campaigns—then adjust targeting and messaging accordingly.
* Stay current on industry trends, competitor events, and emerging categories; bring new ideas for who we should be selling to next.
* Occasionally support the close by stepping in to run pricing/package conversations when needed.

**Qualifications:**

* 0–2 years of experience in sales, customer success, recruiting, fundraising, hospitality, or another role where you had to build relationships and hit goals (internships count).
* Comfortable with outbound outreach (calls \+ email) and willing to practice, iterate, and get better fast.
* Tech savvy: experience using Salesforce (or another CRM) and confidence learning new tools quickly.
* Organized and self\-directed—you can manage a daily outreach plan, follow\-ups, and deadlines without things slipping.
* Strong communication skills: you can write clear, professional messages and speak confidently with new people.
* Be a consultative partner. Apply structured discovery to understand business pain, priorities, stakeholders, and decision process.
* Ability to travel up to 30% (some events require on\-site time).

**Success Metrics:**

* You will be measured on pipeline created, qualified opportunities, conversion, target account penetration, activity effectiveness.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with Gong, ZoomInfo, sales engagement tools, or list\-building tools.
* Comfort with light data analysis (Excel/Google Sheets) to track activity and results.
* Interest in events, media, marketing, or B2B communities—and curiosity about how businesses grow.

 **What success looks like (first 90 days):**

**First 30 Days**  

Learn markets, messaging, systems, and outreach standards.

**60 Days**  

Consistently execute outbound cadence and generate qualified meetings.

**90 Days**  

Create repeatable pipeline contribution and begin influencing targeting and messaging.

 **About Emerald**


At Emerald, we strive to foster a diverse and inclusive community. We actively recruit and champion candidates who bring new perspectives from varied professional backgrounds and experiences, and we are intentional about ensuring a positive hiring experience for everyone. Our job postings don’t contain experience inflation, and most don’t require college degrees. Instead, they’re crafted to focus on outcomes and transferable experiences that are assessed in a structured interview process carried out by trained hiring teams.

 **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS**


Target Compensation: $60,000\-70,000 (Sales Incentive Eligible)


Please note that this range reflects a reasonable estimate of the target compensation for this position. This range may ultimately vary based on a candidate’s qualifications and may be higher where required by applicable law.

  

We offer a competitive benefits package designed to strengthen our employees’ physical and mental health, including unlimited vacation for exempt employees, flexible working locations, 401(k) plan with a company match, medical/dental/vision coverage with inclusive provisions including transgender services and fertility benefits, parental and caregiver leave, dependent, commuter and FSA benefits, professional development programs like Toastmasters, and mental wellness tools.

  

If you need accommodation in our application process or have questions about our posted salary range, please email our Talent Acquisition team at Careers@EmeraldX.com.

jobs.title: Production Coordinator – Imports & Overseas Factories (Mandarin a plus)
jobs.description:
We're a wholesale beauty and cosmetics company in the Garment District.

You'll be a point of contact between our office and our overseas factories and the person who makes sure a sample comes back right the second time.

**What you'll actually do**  
Open sample shipments and compare them against specs. Write clear correction comments (color, packaging, print, fill, component fit) confirmed with our design dept and send them back to the factory.

Chase revisions until they're right.

Track where every style sits against its production calendar and flag slipping dates before they become problems. Sit with production and design teams when a spec question comes up.

**A realistic day:** mornings start with overnight emails from Asia — factory replies land while you're asleep, so the first hour is triage. Afternoons are sample review and internal follow\-up.

**You'll do well here if you**

* Have 1–3 years in wholesale, importing, factory ops, QC, or product development
* Can write a correction email that a factory understands on the first read
* Are comfortable in Excel and moving fast between styles
* Read/write Chinese (helpful for factory correspondence, not required)

**This job is probably not for you if** you want remote or hybrid, prefer one task at a time, or don't like chasing people for answers.

Pay: $49,000\.00 \- $67,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

**Program Coordinator**  

*Southern Regional Education Board (SREB) \| Atlanta, GA (Hybrid) \| Full\-Time, Exempt*  

SREB is looking for a Program Coordinator who enjoys being the person who keeps things moving — the one who tracks the deadline nobody else caught, keeps the contact list current, drafts a clean first pass of the agenda, and makes sure offsite meetings or trainings run without a hitch. If you take real pride in dependable, detail\-oriented follow\-through and want to support meaningful work in education policy, we invite you to apply for our team.**ABOUT SREB**


The Southern Regional Education Board is a nonpartisan, interstate compact that helps its member states improve education from early childhood through doctoral education and into the workforce. SREB does this through reliable data, practical support for implementation, and cross\-state collaboration — producing research, state comparisons, data services, and publications that policymakers and practitioners use every day.**POSITION DETAILS**

* SREB is hiring two Program Coordinators. Both openings will be filled from the same applicant pool — the two strongest candidates will be selected.
* These positions are grant\-funded, with current funding running through December 2029 or July 2031, depending on the grant supporting each position. Additional grants may extend anticipated employment beyond those dates.
* These positions have a hybrid schedule that currently requires working in our mid\-town Atlanta office every Monday and Tuesday and remotely Wednesday, Thursday and Friday. When working remotely, you must be available and free from distractions for the same working hours as in\-office days. You may be required to report to the office other days as needed for business purposes, however, this is infrequent for this role.

**ABOUT THE WORK**


This is a coordination and administrative\-support role assigned to one of SREB's program areas. You'll be the linchpin for the program — organizing meetings and events, maintaining records and contacts, compiling data for reports and proposals, and helping produce clear, well\-edited written materials. You will work closely with a program manager and team in achieving the grant deliverables. It's an individual\-contributor role for someone who finds real satisfaction in doing coordination and support work well and where consistent work is genuinely valued.**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Coordinate the processes, reports, and agreements that keep the program area running smoothly.
* Compile and organize data for reporting, including charts and tables for annual reports.
* Help plan and coordinate meetings, conferences, and workshops, including logistics with other SREB staff and partner organizations.
* Serve as a point of contact for program members and partners, answering questions by phone and email.
* Assist with producing presentations, reports, newsletters, flyers, and other materials.
* Maintain an accurate, up\-to\-date contacts database for the program.
* Maintain relationships with program members, partners, participants, and state agencies.
* Partner with the program manager and Communications staff on website content and e\-communications.
* Contribute ideas and support to strengthen how the team serves its members and partners.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

**Required:*** Two to four years of project management or administrative support experience.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several ongoing tasks and deadlines at once.
* Comfort working independently day to day, with regular check\-ins rather than close supervision.
* Clear, accurate writing and editing skills for presentations, reports, and correspondence.
* A professional, easygoing manner with people from a wide range of backgrounds.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel data functions as well as solid working knowledge of standard office software; comfort learning program\-specific tools.
* Ability to travel overnight.
* Ability to create Google forms with QR codes for meeting or training sign\-in.

**Helpful, but not required:*** Ability to support large\-group Zoom or MS Teams meetings, including breakout rooms
* Event planning experience preferred
* Grant experience preferred

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Starting salary for this position begins at $50,000\.
* Continuous improvement mindset. Every day is an opportunity to grow. Employees are set up to succeed in a workplace that supports continuous learning and development as part of a lifelong journey of achievement.
* Mission and Social Impact that reaches across the nation. SREB focuses on helping states improve education from early childhood through postsecondary and the workforce. Together, we’re shaping stronger futures for students and economies across the South, and the nation.
* Medical, dental and vision
* Life and short\-term disability insurance
* Flexible spending and health savings account options (FSA/HSA)
* Health reimbursement account (HRA)
* Additional voluntary life and long\-term disability options
* Very generous leave programs
* Outstanding 403b retirement plan

**WHY THIS ROLE**

* Steady, well\-organized work that directly supports SREB's mission across member states.
* A collaborative program team and a manager who will set direction and priorities with you.
* A respected, mission\-driven organization with a long track record in Southern education.

**About Bearings Bike Works**

Bearings Bike Works is a faith\-based, mission\-driven organization in Atlanta dedicated to empowering young people through hands\-on learning, mentorship, and career development. We believe hard work is a choice, every job is an opportunity, and that success comes from showing up, taking ownership, and bringing your best—no matter the task. Our Frameworks Career Accelerator Program equips young adults with the technical skills, character, and real\-world experience they need to step confidently into careers and adulthood. The Frameworks Program Specialist is the operational and relational engine of the program: you’ll keep the space ready, keep participants on task, keep communications moving, and keep the whole thing running so that the Program Manager can go deep on curriculum, case management, and job placement.

jobs.description:
**Department**: Client Services  

**Reports to:** Director of Process Operations  

**Direct Reports:** Client Services Coordinator  

**Classification:** Full\-time, Exempt  

**Location:** Office  

Our client is a multi\-state law firm representing national and regional banks, automobile financing lenders, hospitals, medical service providers and other lenders and financial institutions. Their clients hire them to resolve consumer and commercial debts in a professional and respectful manner.

**Position Summary**
====================

  

The Client Services Manager is the firm’s primary day\-to\-day point of contact for assigned creditor clients and is accountable for the health of those relationships. The role owns client communication, performance reporting, requirement management, and escalation resolution, and works across collections, suit preparation, litigation support, compliance, and accounting to make sure the firm delivers what each client contract and operating manual requires.

  

This is a client\-facing operations role, not a legal role. It does not involve the practice of law or the provision of legal advice; case strategy and legal determinations remain with firm attorneys. Success is measured by client retention and placement volume, accuracy and timeliness of reporting, performance against contractual service levels, and the speed with which client issues are resolved and prevented from recurring.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Client Relationship Management**
----------------------------------

* Serve as the named relationship contact for assigned client portfolios, handling routine inquiries, requests, and correspondence with professional, timely, and well\-documented responses.
* Plan and lead recurring client touchpoints, including weekly or monthly operational calls and quarterly business reviews; set agendas, prepare materials, capture commitments, and follow through to closure.
* Maintain a current client requirements matrix for each account covering placement criteria, suit approval thresholds, settlement authority, contact and payment restrictions, reporting formats, and turnaround expectations; distribute changes to affected departments and confirm implementation.
* Anticipate client concerns and raise them internally before they become client complaints; keep firm leadership informed of relationship risk, satisfaction signals, and volume trends.
* Build working relationships across each client organization, not just with the primary contact, so continuity survives turnover on either side.

**Performance Reporting and Analytics**
---------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain reporting templates and recurring queries so monthly production is repeatable and not rebuilt each cycle.
* Track each client’s contractual service levels and scorecard metrics, flag trends before thresholds are breached, and coordinate documented remediation with the responsible department manager.

**Placement Onboarding and Portfolio Management**
-------------------------------------------------

* Coordinate intake of new placements and file transmissions, including data mapping, field validation, exception handling, and confirmation of receipt and load.
* Work with the technical team to resolve transmission failures, data quality issues, and format changes; communicate status and expected resolution to the client without waiting to be asked.
* Manage account\-level client requests including recalls, closures, holds, media and document requests, balance and interest adjustments, disputes, bankruptcy and deceased notifications, and servicemember status.
* Coordinate remittance reporting and invoicing with accounting; research and resolve payment posting, fee calculation, and reconciliation questions.
* Support onboarding of new clients and new portfolio types, including operating manual review, workflow configuration requirements, reporting setup, and internal training on client\-specific rules.

**Escalations, Complaints, and Audit Support**
----------------------------------------------

* Own client\-forwarded escalations end to end: acknowledge quickly, investigate the underlying account and process history, document findings, and deliver a written response within the client’s required turnaround.
* Route consumer complaints and regulatory or attorney general inquiries to Compliance promptly and supply the account history and operational context needed for response.
* Support Compliance during client audits and examinations by gathering operational data, coordinating departmental responses, and tracking client\-facing commitments made in corrective action plans.
* Identify recurring escalation themes and drive root cause correction with the responsible department rather than resolving the same issue repeatedly.

**Internal Coordination and Team Leadership**
---------------------------------------------

* Supervise, train, and develop client services staff; set clear expectations, distribute portfolio coverage, and maintain documented backup coverage for every account.
* Maintain standard operating procedures for client services workflows, response templates, and reporting production.
* Translate client requirements into concrete process and system changes with collections, suit preparation, litigation support, and technology; verify that changes are implemented and hold.
* Contribute to requests for proposal, capability presentations, and prospective client due diligence, including firm profile materials and reference reporting.
* Identify, evaluate, and adopt artificial intelligence and automation tools that improve the speed and quality of client work — including reporting production, account history research for escalations, data analysis, and drafting of client materials — and move successful pilots into documented routine use.
* Apply and enforce the firm’s standards for AI use in client work: human verification of every client\

jobs.description:
Discover Your Career at Emory University:

Emory University is a leading research university that fosters excellence and attracts world\-class talent to innovate today and prepare leaders for the future. We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community.
Description:

The Clinical Research Coordinator II handles administrative activities generally associated with the conduct of clinical trials. This position requires flexibility to accommodate the unique demands of research involving pregnant participants and delivery\-based biospecimen collection. Because deliveries can occur at any time, the coordinator may be required to work during evenings, weekends, or overnight hours to ensure timely collection and processing of samples within strict protocol timelines. A shifted schedule and participation in an on\-call rotation may be implemented as needed to maintain continuous study coverage.  

Coordinators are expected to demonstrate initiative and accountability for study\-related responsibilities, maintain a high level of productivity and attention to detail, and communicate proactively with study leadership regarding project progress and scheduling needs.  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:* Manages research project databases, develops flow sheets and other study related documents, and completes source documents/case report forms.
* Provides guidance to less experienced staff.
* Interfaces with research participants, determines eligibility and consents study participants according to protocol.
* Approves orders for supplies and equipment maintenance.
* Assists in developing recruitment strategies and conducting screenings for study participants including interviews and questionnaires.
* Supervises collection of study specimens and processing.
* Establishes case packages for study procedures, monitors scheduling of procedures and charges, coordinates other services as needed.
* Ensures compliance with research protocols, reviews case report forms and audits for accuracy with source documents, attends monitoring meetings with sponsors.
* Prepares regulatory submissions.
* With appropriate credentialing and training may perform phlebotomy or diagnostics.
* Performs related approved responsibilities as required.
* Assists in the coordination and implementation of clinical research studies, including participant recruitment, enrollment, and follow\-up in accordance with study protocols and regulatory requirements.
* Reviews medical records and conducts participant screenings to assess eligibility; obtains informed consent and administers study questionnaires or quality\-of\-life assessments as required.
* Collects, processes, and prepares biospecimens for shipment in compliance with study and institutional standards; may perform phlebotomy and related specimen handling procedures.
* Maintains accurate and complete study documentation, including source documents, case report forms, and data entry into approved databases.
* Coordinates study\-related activities such as scheduling study visits, preparing case packages, ordering supplies, and maintaining study equipment.
* Participates in study meetings and contributes to ongoing communication with the principal investigator and study team to ensure timelines and objectives are met.
* Assists with quality assurance procedures and supports the preparation and tracking of regulatory submissions.
* Assists with screening participants, coordinating data and specimen collection at participating Emory hospitals, and supporting collaboration for timely biospecimen processing.
* Performs other related duties as assigned to support the success of the research program.

  

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:* High School Diploma or GED and five years of clinical research experience.
* Or two years of college in a scientific, health related, or business administration program and three years clinical research experience.

* Or a Bachelor's degree in a scientific, health related, or business administration related program and one year of clinical research experience.
* Or a Master's degree, MD or PhD in a scientific, health related or business administration program.

jobs.description:
**Help Clients Protect What Matters Most**

Chandler Law is seeking a professional, organized, and service\-minded Client Services Coordinator to guide prospective and current clients through each step of their experience with our firm.

As a Client Services Coordinator, you will be an important part of each client’s experience with Chandler Law. Often serving as a client’s first point of contact, you will help build trust from the very beginning and provide attentive, professional support throughout their relationship with the firm. By coordinating communications, meetings, document signings, and ongoing services, you will help ensure every client receives a seamless and personalized experience.

Chandler Law helps Georgia families plan for their futures and protect the people and legacies that matter most to them. The firm also serves attorneys and law firms through professional\-liability defense, ethics guidance, disciplinary defense, alternative dispute resolution, and succession planning. **Workshops and Attorney Support**

The Erosion Company (TEC), headquartered in Woodstock, Georgia, is a leading nationwide erosion control specialty contractor serving the construction, infrastructure, and renewable energy industries. jobs.title: Studio Client and Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
Studio Client \& Social Media Coordinator

**SPRAY STUDIO® \| Sandy Springs / Atlanta**

SPRAY STUDIO® is looking for someone who knows how to run a front desk, loves the beauty industry, understands social media beyond just posting a cute photo — and can bring all three together.

This role sits right in the middle of the SPRAY STUDIO experience. You’ll be one of the first people our clients see when they walk in, the person keeping the studio organized behind the scenes, and part of the voice they see when they find us online.

We’re looking for someone with **real front desk experience in the beauty industry AND professional experience managing social media for a business or brand.**

Both matter.

You don’t necessarily need to come from a spray tanning studio, but you should genuinely enjoy the sunless tanning and beauty space. Salon, hair, skincare, med spa, cosmetics, boutique beauty or similar experience can translate really well.

If you already know your way around spray tanning? Even better.

FRONT DESK \+ CLIENT EXPERIENCE

You’ll help keep the studio moving while making sure every client feels taken care of from the minute they walk in.

* Welcome clients and create a warm, polished studio experience
* Manage appointments, reschedules, cancellations and client questions
* Answer phones, texts, emails and studio messages
* Handle check\-in, checkout, payments, memberships, retail purchases and rebooking
* Manage appointment flow during busy days
* Get to know our regular clients and help build lasting relationships
* Handle client concerns or service issues professionally
* Communicate with artists and the rest of the studio team throughout the day
* Keep the front desk and client areas organized, stocked and ready

We move fast. You should be someone who can have a client in front of you, a phone ringing, an appointment changing and a team member asking you a question — and still keep it together.

SOCIAL MEDIA \+ BRAND SUPPORT

We want someone who understands that **managing social media is different from occasionally posting on the company Instagram.**

You should have experience helping manage a brand or business account and understand how to keep a social presence active, consistent and actually interesting.

You’ll help:

* Plan and maintain a consistent social media calendar
* Create and publish Instagram content, Stories and Reels
* Capture photos and short\-form video in the studio
* Write captions that sound like SPRAY STUDIO
* Highlight products, tans, artists, clients, promotions and what’s happening in the studio
* Monitor comments and DMs and help keep engagement timely
* Identify trends that make sense for our brand
* Track basic performance and understand what content is connecting
* Help keep the brand consistent across what clients experience online and in person

You should be comfortable picking up a phone and creating content — not waiting for someone to tell you exactly what to photograph, film or post every time.

YOU’LL PROBABLY LOVE THIS ROLE IF...

You genuinely like the beauty industry.

You understand why someone cares about the difference between an okay tan and a GREAT tan.

You notice when the front desk doesn’t look right.

You remember clients.

You can talk to people without sounding scripted.

You know your way around Instagram.

You understand what makes a Reel watchable.

You’re organized enough to follow a content calendar but creative enough to know when something happening in the studio needs to be captured right now.

And you like working somewhere that is fun, social and fast\-paced without being chaotic or unprofessional.

WHAT WE NEED

**Front Desk Experience — Required**

Previous experience working a busy front desk in a salon, spa, tanning studio, med spa, beauty retailer or similar appointment\-based beauty business.

You should already understand appointment management, client communication, checkout, rebooking and the pace of a busy beauty environment.

**Social Media Experience — Required**

Previous responsibility for managing social media for a business, brand or organization.

We want to hear about the accounts you’ve actually helped manage, what you were responsible for and the types of content you created.

Experience with Instagram Stories, Reels and short\-form video is strongly preferred.

**Beauty Industry Experience — Strongly Preferred**

Experience in tanning, hair, skincare, salons, spas, med spas, cosmetics, beauty retail or another beauty\-focused environment.

**Sunless/Tanning Knowledge — Strongly Preferred**

You don’t have to be a spray tan artist, but you should understand the industry, be interested in learning our products and services, and genuinely connect with the SPRAY STUDIO brand.

ALSO HELPFUL

* Booker, Vagaro, Mindbody, Boulevard or similar booking systems
* Canva
* Instagram and Meta tools
* Google Workspace
* Basic Excel/Google Sheets
* Retail or product sales
* Content planning
* Customer service and client recovery

THE PERSONALITY FIT

We’re a small, collaborative team, so how you work matters.

We’re looking for someone who is:

* Friendly and naturally comfortable with people
* Confident without needing to be the center of attention
* Detail\-oriented
* Dependable
* Quick on their feet
* Comfortable taking initiative
* Creative but organized
* Professional while still having personality
* Excited to learn the SPRAY STUDIO way of doing things

We care about giving clients an experience that feels fun, welcoming and genuinely good from start to finish.

SCHEDULE

This is an **in\-person position at our Sandy Springs / Atlanta studio.**

Flexibility for daytime, evening and weekend shifts is required based on studio needs.

PAY \+ PERKS

**$23–$25/hour, based on experience**

Plus:

* Paid training and mentorship
* Complimentary spray tans
* Generous product discounts
* Bonus opportunities and performance incentives
* Opportunity to grow as the studio and brand continue to grow

WANT TO FAST\

Emerald’s talented and experienced teams grow our customers’ businesses 365 days a year with products that create connections, deliver content, and drive commerce. We produce over 140 annual events, create and deliver content through print and digital channels, and power commerce through our seamlessly integrated in\-person and digital platforms and channels. For more information, please visit http://www.emeraldx.com.

  

Emerald is seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Event Operations Manager to lead the planning and execution of tradeshows and events. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with internal teams and external partners to manage budgets, logistics, vendor relationships, and onsite operations with a strong focus on efficiency and delivering exceptional experiences.

  

The Event Operations Manager collaborates extensively with internal teams and external partners to manage spending, contracts, onsite design, logistics, and show collateral. They ensure all stakeholders remain informed as plans evolve and oversee all preplanning and onsite operational aspects while maintaining strong relationships with partners and Emerald personnel.

  

The ideal candidate is an organized, collaborative leader who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and embodies Emerald’s values: people, leadership, agility, commitment, and excellence.

**Event Planning, Coordination, and Evaluation**

* Plan and execute all assigned events and support others as needed
* Develop show production timelines to ensure proper and timely coordination of all event components
* Facilitate pre\-show and post\-show event meetings and participate in weekly show team meetings
* Develop operations post\-event assessment to ensure feedback document issues that inform future planning

**Budgeting \& Financial Management**

* Develop and maintain event budgets and expenses, including identifying cost saving measures related to operating expenses
* Manage budget revisions and monthly accruals
* Maintain payment schedules and contractual deposits
* Process vendor invoices for payment and reconcile credit card expenses in alignment with monthly deadlines

**Vendor Management \& Contracting**

* Create RFPs for ancillary vendors, review and analyze proposals and provide recommendations to leadership for vendor selection
* Manage SOWs and schedules for core show partners, such as first aid, security and cleaning
* Review facility and hotel contracts as required

**Floorplan, Logistics \& Production**

* Plan and manage lounges and specialty areas on the show floor
* Collaborate internally on housing requirements for staff, VIP, speakers, etc. as required
* Actively manage show housing in coordination with the housing agency and work collaboratively to ensure attrition is avoided

**Conference Programs \& Special Events**

* Contract venues/spaces, manage logistics, and oversee execution of special events
* Assist with the conference program as directed, including supporting audio\-visual contracting/coordination, meeting room setups, and related signage, etc.

**Onsite Execution \& Show Operations**

* Lead onsite operations across move\-in, show staging, and move\-out, ensuring timelines, safety standards, and service requirements are met
* Manage onsite vendors and coordinate with venue teams and Emerald colleagues to problem solve in real\-time
* Maintain exhibitor, sponsor, and attendee experience standards through active floor management and problem resolution
* Ensure compliance with facility regulations, union requirements, and emergency procedures throughout the event
* Document issues and opportunities for future events to be shared in post\-event assessment
* Ensure a positive and collaborative spirit is maintained in all interactions with colleagues, partners, and customers

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3\+ years of experience in event operations
* Strong understanding of event planning principles, requirements, and procedures
* High emotional intelligence and calm under pressure
* Ability to stay highly organized and efficient while handling multiple shows with overlapping planning and execution cycles
* Proven experience leading a team and managing external partners
* Demonstrated ability to create and manage event budgets
* Proficient in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook; SmartSheet and A2Z experience a plus
* Ability to travel up to 50% including extended time on show site for move\-in, show execution, and move\-out

At Emerald, we strive to foster a diverse and inclusive community. **Client Experience Coordinator**

Waxing the City is looking for an outgoing, energetic, and highly personable **Client Experience Coordinator** to support our Alpharetta and Cumming studios.  

This isn’t just a front desk position.  

We’re looking for someone who loves people, genuinely enjoys talking with clients, and understands that **every interaction is an opportunity to create an amazing experience**.  

You’ll be one of the faces of our brand—welcoming clients, building relationships, supporting our Cerologists, helping keep the studios running smoothly, and finding creative ways to introduce more people in our community to Waxing the City.  

The ideal person is someone who brings **positive energy wherever they go**. You’re friendly, polished, organized, comfortable starting conversations, and willing to jump in wherever you’re needed.
